text.zh: 现生成员包括马、犀和貘。承重轴经过第三指（趾），但不能据此把所有成员说成只有奇数个趾：貘的前足有四趾。它们通过后肠发酵利用植物性食物。
text.en: Living members include horses, rhinoceroses and tapirs. The weight-bearing axis passes through the third digit; this does not mean every foot has an odd number of toes, since tapir forefeet have four. Plant food is processed by hindgut fermentation.

text.zh: 蝶和蛾的成虫体表与翅通常覆盖鳞片。许多成虫用可卷曲的喙吸取液体，但也有保留咀嚼口器或口器退化的类群。
text.en: Adult moths and butterflies usually bear scales on their bodies and wings. Many sip liquids through a coiled proboscis, while some groups retain chewing mouthparts or have reduced mouthparts.

text.zh: 毛虫阶段通常咀嚼植物组织，随后经过蛹期转变为成虫。蝶与蛾不能仅凭白天或夜间活动区分：有些蛾也在白天活动。
text.en: Caterpillars commonly chew plant tissue before pupation and adult emergence. Day versus night activity alone cannot distinguish butterflies from moths: some moths are active by day.

text.zh: 包括蚁、蜂和叶蜂。有翅成虫的前后翅通过小钩连接，发育经历蛹期；工蚁等无翅成员仍属于本目。叶蜂的胸腹连接较宽，不能用“细腰”识别全部成员。
text.en: This order includes ants, bees, wasps and sawflies. Winged adults couple their wings with small hooks and development includes a pupa. Wingless workers still belong here; broad-waisted sawflies show why a narrow waist is not universal.

text.zh: 访花、植食、捕食和拟寄生等生活方式并存。拟寄生蜂的幼虫利用寄主发育并最终使其死亡；蚂蚁或蜜蜂的群居生活不能代表所有蜂类。
text.en: Flower visiting, herbivory, predation and parasitoid life histories coexist. Parasitoid larvae develop at a host’s expense and ultimately kill it. Ant and honey-bee colonies do not represent all wasp and bee lifestyles.

scope.en: Wing coupling, complete metamorphosis and feeding diversity; excludes older natural-group and exclusivity claims about sawflies and sociality.

text.en: Hemiptera includes cicadas, aphids, scale insects and true bugs. Feeding uses piercing-sucking mouthparts. A hardened wing base and membranous tip characterize many true bugs, not the entire order.

text.zh: 通常以不完全变态发育，若虫经蜕皮成为成虫。许多成员吸食植物汁液，也有捕食其他动物或吸血的种；部分异翅类生活在淡水水面或水中。
text.en: Development is generally incomplete metamorphosis, with nymphs molting into adults. Many feed on plant fluids; others are predators or blood feeders. Some true bugs live on or within fresh water.

scope.en: Piercing-sucking mouthparts, incomplete metamorphosis and habitats; excludes older suborder counts and Australian species totals.

text.en: Many lady-beetle larvae and adults prey on aphids, scale insects and other small animals, but plant-feeding members also occur. Similar appearance does not establish species identity or a predatory diet.

scope.en: Only the Coccinellidae account’s distinction between predatory and plant-feeding members; biological control is not assigned to every species.

text.en: Many adults resemble bees or wasps but are flies. Some larvae eat aphids, while others use decaying plant material. The family name must not be interpreted as an aphid-feeding rule for every larva.

text.en: Common adults hold reduced forelegs close to the body rather than walking on them, giving the appearance of four walking legs. This is an observation clue; species identification requires additional characters.

text.en: Workers commonly have elbowed antennae and a distinct waist and are usually wingless; reproductives may have wings. Identification combines body connections and antennae rather than wing presence alone.

text.zh: 常见蚜虫身体柔软，利用细长口器吸食植物汁液；许多种腹部后方有一对腹管。同一种可出现有翅和无翅个体，颜色也不足以单独鉴定物种。
text.en: Common aphids have soft bodies and slender mouthparts for extracting plant fluids; many bear paired cornicles near the abdomen’s rear. A species may produce winged and wingless forms, and color alone is not a species diagnosis.

text.zh: 许多种能孤雌生殖，部分种在特定季节产生有性世代。温和地区的观察不能直接作为所有蚜虫在全球各地的固定生活史。
text.en: Many species reproduce parthenogenetically; some produce sexual generations seasonally. Observations from mild climates do not establish a fixed life cycle for all aphids everywhere.

scope.zh: 常见蚜虫的形态、翅型和繁殖差异；加州季节与防治建议不作全球结论。
scope.en: Common aphid morphology, wing forms and reproductive variation; California seasonality and control advice are not generalized globally.

text.en: Colonies contain queens, workers and drones. Workers collect pollen and nectar, produce wax and care for brood, with tasks changing with age. Swarming can establish new colonies.

text.zh: 原生分布涉及欧洲、非洲和中东，人类养蜂使它广泛传播到原生范围之外。饲养或逸生记录不能直接证明当地原生分布。
text.en: Native populations occur in Europe, Africa and the Middle East, while beekeeping has spread the species widely beyond that range. Managed or feral records do not establish local native status.

text.en: Caterpillars feed on milkweeds in Asclepias, then pupate before adult emergence. Larval host plants and adult flower resources meet different life-history needs.

text.zh: 北美一些种群有显著的季节迁徙，也存在定居种群。不能把一个迁徙种群的行为、数量变化或威胁程度直接代表整个物种。
text.en: Some North American populations make seasonal migrations, while resident populations also occur. One migratory population’s behavior, abundance trend or threats cannot stand for the entire species.

scope.zh: 幼虫寄主、蛹及迁徙与定居种群差异；不采用旧保育结论、迁徙距离或已过时的植物科名。

text.en: Larvae prey on aphids on trees, shrubs and herbs; adults regularly visit flowers. Different developmental stages of one species can therefore play different food-web roles.

text.en: British records include continental immigrants and overwintering adults. Annual variation in local records cannot directly quantify changes in global population size.

scope.zh: 物种幼虫食物、成虫访花与英国记录解释；区域记录频数不是全球种群估计。
scope.en: Larval diet, adult flower visiting and interpretation of British records; regional record frequency is not a global population estimate.

text.zh: “食肉目”不是饮食清单：目内成员的食性多样，熊、浣熊和鳍足类的裂齿也发生了不同程度的改变；而蝙蝠、有袋类和鲸豚等目外哺乳动物同样会捕食。读这个名称时，应把分类身份与实际食谱分开。
text.en: “Carnivora” is not a diet list. Feeding habits vary within the order, and the carnassial teeth are modified in bears, raccoons and pinnipeds; mammals outside the order, including bats, marsupials and cetaceans, also prey on animals. Taxonomic membership and actual diet need to be kept separate.

scope.en: Supports the distinction between diet and taxonomic membership and the stated variation in carnassial form; the page’s order counts, conservation material and divergence dates are not used.

text.zh: 犬科的典型身体线索不是一张“狼的画像”：较深的胸腔、延长的口鼻部和不能缩回的爪，与较长肢段相伴；页面同时指出郊狼、狐、狼和家犬等成员的食物及社会行为并不相同。
text.en: A canid is not simply a wolf-shaped template. A deep chest, elongated muzzle and non-retractile claws occur with relatively long limbs; the account also describes varied diets and social behavior among coyotes, foxes, wolves and domestic dogs.

sources.title: Animal Diversity Web — Canidae (Bridget Fahey and Phil Myers)

scope.en: Supports the described canid body-form traits and variation in diet and social behavior; family counts, older classification and management statements are not used.

text.zh: 狐属的辨识故事要从头骨和尾巴一起看：ADW 概述以较小体型、扁平头骨、尖口鼻和蓬松大尾描述“真狐”，并将沙漠中的耳廓狐与北极狐并列为不同环境中的属内例子。属级外形不能替代逐种鉴定。
text.en: The account identifies “true foxes” by a combination of relatively small size, flattened skull, pointed muzzle and large bushy tail, then contrasts fennec foxes in deserts with Arctic foxes in tundra. These genus-level cues do not replace species-level identification.

text.zh: 属内栖境从沙漠延伸到北极，也包括山地与平原；取食与庇护机会、以及人类聚居环境会影响狐类出现的地点。该范围说明属内差异，不能理解为每一种狐都占据全部这些生境。
text.en: Habitats described across the genus extend from desert to Arctic conditions and include mountains and plains; food, shelter and human settlement affect where foxes occur. This is a genus-level contrast, not a claim that every fox species occupies all of these habitats.

sources.title: Animal Diversity Web — Vulpes (Tru Hubbard)

scope.zh: 支持属级形态、沙漠至北极的环境对照与人类改造生境中的观察；页面中的属内数量和旧系统分类不作为当前清单或演化证据。
scope.en: Supports genus-level morphology, the desert-to-Arctic habitat contrast and observations in human-modified settings; the page’s genus counts and older systematic account are not treated as a current inventory or evolutionary evidence.

limitations.en: Source-linked introductory account; not externally expert-reviewed. The ADW Vulpes page was last updated in 2019; its living/fossil counts and older systematic relationships are not reused as pinned-tree counts or current phylogenetic conclusions.

text.zh: 赤狐并非总是鲜红色：ADW 所记毛色从浅黄红到深红褐，腹面可发白或灰暗，腿下部常为黑色，尾尖可白可黑；其体型也随种群与纬度变化。页面给出的体长和体重范围来自旧资料，未作为本条的定量值。
text.en: Red foxes are not always bright red: the ADW account describes upper fur from pale yellow-red to deep reddish brown, a white or gray underside, often-black lower legs and either a white or black tail tip. Body size also varies among populations and with latitude. The page’s older length and mass ranges are not reused here.

text.zh: 这是一种跨越北半球广阔区域的狐，且在澳大利亚等地有引入种群；森林、苔原、荒漠、农田和城市都见于来源记载。原生范围与引入记录须分开，不能把出现地点直接等同于原生分布。
text.en: This fox spans a broad Northern Hemisphere range and has introduced populations in places such as Australia; the source records it in forests, tundra, deserts, farmland and cities. Native range and introductions must be kept separate: an occurrence does not by itself establish native status.

text.zh: 赤狐的繁殖不能简化为固定的“一夫一妻”：来源记有单配、雄狐多配及非繁殖雌狐帮育等情形；其所述繁殖季还随南北位置推迟。洞穴中的幼仔由亲代照料，雄狐可在雌狐留守产仔洞时带来食物。
text.en: Red fox breeding is not reducible to fixed monogamy: the account records monogamous and polygynous pairings as well as non-breeding female helpers, and reports later breeding seasons farther north. Parents care for young at the den; a male may provision the female while she remains there around birth.

sources.title: Animal Diversity Web — Vulpes vulpes (David L. Fox)

scope.zh: 支持页面所载毛色、栖境、原生/引入区分及繁殖行为范围；繁殖季的南北对照沿用该旧概述的限定，旧体重、体长、保育等级和全球现状不导入。
scope.en: Supports the account’s coat variation, habitats, native/introduced distinction and range of breeding behaviors; the south-to-north season contrast remains bounded to this older account. Old mass, length, conservation status and claims about current global conditions are excluded.

limitations.en: Source-linked introductory account; not externally expert-reviewed. The ADW red fox page was last updated in 2007; quantitative traits, a global breeding calendar, complete native/introduced ranges, current conservation status and present population trends require separate, newer evidence.

text.zh: 蜘蛛不是昆虫：头胸部与腹部由细腰相连，四对步足、触肢和纺器各有分工。丝也不等于网；蜘蛛会用它筑网、裹猎物、护卵、做庇护所和安全线。
text.en: Spiders are arachnids, not insects: the cephalothorax and abdomen are joined by a narrow pedicel, and the four pairs of walking legs, pedipalps and spinnerets have distinct roles. Silk is not synonymous with a web; it can capture prey, wrap it, protect eggs, line retreats and serve as a safety line.

text.zh: 澳大利亚博物馆记载的生活史展示了丝的另一用途：雌蛛以丝包裹卵，幼蛛孵出后可步行扩散，也可借丝线跨越邻近枝叶，或让细丝乘风带走。这里描述的是博物馆概述的多种蜘蛛策略，并非每种蜘蛛都采用每一种方式。
text.en: The Australian Museum describes silk beyond prey capture: females wrap eggs in silk, and spiderlings may disperse by walking, bridging between nearby foliage on a line, or letting fine silk catch the breeze. These are different strategies reported across spiders, not behaviors attributed to every species.

sources.title: Australian Museum — Spiders

scope.zh: 支持蜘蛛与昆虫的区别、身体分区、丝的多种功能和幼蛛扩散方式；页面中的澳大利亚物种数量、危险性概括和保育表述未导入。
scope.en: Supports the distinction from insects, body regions, multiple silk functions and spiderling dispersal; Australian species counts, danger summaries and conservation statements on the page are not imported.

limitations.en: Source-linked introductory account; not externally expert-reviewed. The Australian Museum overview is not a global taxonomic or complete life-history catalogue; spiderling behaviors and regional observations remain bounded to the source.

text.zh: 澳洲漏斗网蛛科中，腹端纺器与雄蛛第二步足能提供鉴别线索，但性状要放在科内比较：澳大利亚博物馆指出，第二步足胫节上的明显交配距是 Atrax 属的特征，其他漏斗网蛛属的雄蛛在此处形态不同。
text.en: Spinnerets and the male second leg help distinguish Australian funnel-webs, but the traits must be compared within the family. The Australian Museum describes a conspicuous mating spur on the second-leg tibia as characteristic of Atrax; males in the other funnel-web genera differ in this feature.

sources.title: Australian Museum — Australian Funnel-web Spiders

scope.en: Supports family-level appearance and the male second-leg distinction between Atrax and other funnel-web genera; the page’s older family count, venom rankings and medical claims are not imported.

limitations.en: Source-linked introductory account; not externally expert-reviewed. The biological account is about Australian funnel-webs; its genus and species counts change with taxonomic revision and are not treated as a current inventory.

text.zh: 一次由异常大的纽卡斯尔雄蛛触发的复查，重新检验了悉尼地区漏斗网蛛的物种边界。研究者比较新采标本与博物馆历史标本的形态和 DNA，将过去合并看待的对象区分为悉尼漏斗网蛛 Atrax robustus、恢复使用的 A. montanus 和新描述的 A. christenseni。这个结论针对悉尼地区该复合群，不是对全属的系统发育重建。
text.en: Unusually large Newcastle males prompted a re-examination of species boundaries in Sydney-region funnel-webs. By comparing morphology and DNA from newly collected and historical museum specimens, researchers distinguished the Sydney funnel-web Atrax robustus, reinstated A. montanus and newly described A. christenseni. This result concerns that regional species complex, not a phylogenetic reconstruction of the whole genus.

sources.title: Loria et al. 2025 — The world’s most venomous spider is a species complex: systematics of the Sydney funnel-web spider

scope.zh: 2025 年研究以形态和分子数据重新分析悉尼地区漏斗网蛛复合群；仅支持该研究采样、方法及其三种界定，不外推至全属或全球漏斗网蛛。
scope.en: The 2025 study reassessed the Sydney-region funnel-web complex using morphology and molecular data; it supports only the sampled group, methods and three species delimitations, not the whole genus or all funnel-web spiders worldwide.

sources.title: Australian Museum — Scientists resolve identity crisis for Australia’s deadliest spider

scope.en: Research-team news release; used only for collection-comparison context, with species delimitation grounded in the linked 2025 paper.

limitations.en: Source-linked introductory account; not externally expert-reviewed. Delimitations are bounded to the Sydney-region material and analysis in the 2025 study; the pinned checklist enables exact name lookup but does not resolve wider taxonomic debate.

text.zh: 悉尼漏斗网蛛在潮湿、遮蔽处筑丝衬洞穴，把不规则丝质感应线铺到洞口外；甲虫、蟑螂等猎物触线产生振动后，蜘蛛从洞口突袭。雄蛛成熟后会在暖季夜间离洞寻找雌蛛，这也解释了为何城市边缘偶会遇到游走雄蛛。
text.en: The Sydney funnel-web occupies cool, humid retreats and silk-lines its burrow, extending irregular trip-lines outside the entrance. When prey such as beetles or cockroaches disturb a line, the spider rushes from the burrow. Mature males leave to search for females on warm-season nights, explaining why wandering males are occasionally encountered near urban habitat.

text.zh: 按澳大利亚博物馆结合 2025 年研究更新的范围，该种主要从新南威尔士州中央海岸至乔治河、向西至 Baulkham Hills；部分记录来自蓝山和卧龙岗。它与南悉尼漏斗网蛛 A. montanus 的分布重叠，因此不能仅凭地区或外观确认种名。
text.en: In the range updated by the Australian Museum using the 2025 study, this species occurs mainly from the Central Coast of New South Wales south to the Georges River and west to Baulkham Hills, with some records from the Blue Mountains and Wollongong. Its range overlaps that of the Southern Sydney funnel-web, A. montanus, so locality or general appearance alone cannot confirm an identification.

limitations.en: Source-linked introductory account; not externally expert-reviewed. Range statements derive from research and museum material in New South Wales, Australia and are not a complete global range; old venom rankings, fatality counts and conservation status are not imported.

text.zh: A. montanus 曾在分类处理中被并入悉尼漏斗网蛛的种内变异；2025 年对悉尼地区复合群的形态与分子分析恢复了这个 1914 年发表的名称。博物馆指出它与 A. robustus 外观相似而分布重叠，说明旧名称和粗略外观都不足以单独判种。
text.en: Atrax montanus was once treated within the variation of the Sydney funnel-web; a 2025 morphological and molecular analysis of the regional complex restored the name published in 1914. The Museum notes that it resembles A. robustus and overlaps its range, showing why an old name or general appearance alone is insufficient for identification.

text.zh: 澳大利亚博物馆记载其在新南威尔士州从 Watagans 向南至 Bowral、向西至上蓝山；较偏南和偏西的分布与悉尼漏斗网蛛重叠。局部地点记载来自该州，不能外推为整个澳洲的分布。
text.en: The Australian Museum records this species in New South Wales from the Watagans south to Bowral and west to the upper Blue Mountains; its more southerly and westerly range overlaps the Sydney funnel-web. These are regional records, not a range for all of Australia.

text.zh: 来自纽卡斯尔、体型异常大的雄蛛促成复查，研究团队随后把原先并入 A. robustus 的纽卡斯尔种群命名为新种 A. christenseni。雄蛛可用较长的触肢胫节与栓子形态区别近似种，但单看体型不可靠。
text.en: Unusually large males from Newcastle prompted a reassessment, after which the research team named that population—formerly included in A. robustus—as the new species A. christenseni. Males can be distinguished from similar species by the longer palpal tibia and embolus; size alone is unreliable.

text.zh: 澳大利亚博物馆报告的记录集中在纽卡斯尔周围 25 公里范围，且未公开精确栖地位置；该物种的生物学资料仍有限。狭窄的已知记录区不等于已经完整测定其全部分布。
text.en: Records reported by the Australian Museum are concentrated within 25 km of Newcastle, and precise localities are withheld; biological information remains limited. A narrow known-record area is not proof that the full distribution has been measured.

text.zh: 在广西 Encheng 自然保护区的一项十个月研究中，单个野生群体取食了 101 种植物，还摄入峭壁矿物和至少一种昆虫。食物短缺时期，果实和嫩叶的取食随可获得量下降，成熟叶和种子则作为替代食物。这些观察来自一个破碎化喀斯特地点和一个群体。
text.en: In a ten-month study at Encheng Nature Reserve in Guangxi, one wild group ate 101 plant species, cliff minerals and at least one insect species. During food-scarce periods, fruit and young-leaf consumption declined as availability fell, while mature leaves and seeds served as alternatives. These observations come from one group at a fragmented karst site.

text.zh: 2022 年 3 月在贵州 Mayanghe 和 Dashahe 两处保护区采集的 27 份新鲜粪便样本，检出合计 134 个植物科和 336 个属；作者报告两地食物组成有差异。样本覆盖四个野生群体，但只取自同一季节，不能代表全年食谱或整个分布区。
text.en: Dietary metabarcoding of 27 fresh fecal samples from four wild populations at the Mayanghe and Dashahe reserves in Guizhou, collected in March 2022, identified 134 plant families and 336 genera across the two sites. The authors reported regional differences in composition. The same-season sample does not describe year-round diet or the full range.

text.zh: 在贵州 Kuankuoshui，一个高海拔保护区群体于 2008 年 4 月至 2009 年 3 月接受跟踪。按网格单元估算的年度家域为 50.7 公顷，冬春季为 37.7 公顷，夏秋季为 27.7 公顷。论文不同段落给出的年度最小凸多边形估值互相冲突，因此这里仅报告网格估值。
text.en: At Kuankuoshui in Guizhou, one group in high-altitude habitat was followed from April 2008 to March 2009. The grid-cell estimator gave an annual home range of 50.7 hectares, with seasonal estimates of 37.7 hectares in winter–spring and 27.7 hectares in summer–autumn. The paper gives conflicting annual minimum-convex-polygon values, so only the grid-cell estimates are reported here.

text.zh: 一项线粒体控制区研究对 178 只菲氏叶猴测序了 395 个碱基片段，识别出 29 种单倍型；其线粒体系统树将菲氏叶猴样本恢复为相对于两种近缘叶猴的多系群。作者指出，单一母系遗传标记不足以确定物种关系，并建议增加核基因位点。这是该研究的结果，不构成对 COL26.8 接受分类的修订。
text.en: A mitochondrial control-region study sequenced a 395-base-pair fragment from 178 François' langurs and identified 29 haplotypes. Its mitochondrial trees recovered the sampled species as polyphyletic relative to two closely related langurs. The authors noted that one maternally inherited marker was insufficient to settle the relationships and called for nuclear loci. This is the study's result, not a revision of the COL26.8 accepted taxonomy.

text.zh: 在加蓬 Loango 国家公园，一项研究跟踪了一个由 10 只西部低地大猩猩组成的群体，从 2018 年 1 月到 2020 年 7 月累计观察 5,896 小时、652 天。两个完整年份的取食扫描估计，取食时间约 31% 用于果实、21% 用于草本、31% 用于树木食物、10% 用于坚果，昆虫为 0%。这些是一个群体的地点性估计。
text.en: At Loango National Park in Gabon, a study followed one group of 10 western lowland gorillas from January 2018 to July 2020, recording 5,896 observation hours over 652 days. Scan-based estimates for the two complete years assigned about 31% of feeding time to fruit, 21% to herbs, 31% to tree foods, 10% to nuts and 0% to insects. These are local estimates for one group.

text.zh: 同一 Loango 群体的 31 个月记录中，果实可获得量与用于取食果实的扫描比例呈正相关（Pearson r = 0.623，p < 0.001）。这说明该群体、该地点观察到两项指标共同变化；它不能单独证明因果关系，也不能代表全物种的季节性取食规律。
text.en: Across 31 monthly observations of the same Loango group, fruit availability was positively correlated with the proportion of feeding scans spent eating fruit (Pearson r = 0.623, p < 0.001). This describes covariation at one site; it does not establish causation or a species-wide seasonal pattern.

text.zh: Mbeli Bai 的两次野外记录显示，成年雌性西部大猩猩曾使用折断的植物材料辅助行动：2004 年 10 月 9 日，Leah 用树枝探测水深并在涉水时保持平衡；同年 11 月 21 日，Efi 用灌木干稳定取食，随后把它当作短桥越过沼地。这两例不能估算行为发生频率或习得过程。
text.en: Two field observations at Mbeli Bai recorded adult female western gorillas using detached plant material to assist movement. On 9 October 2004, Leah used a branch to probe water depth and steady herself; on 21 November, Efi used a shrub trunk to stabilize food processing and then as a short bridge over swampy ground. Two cases cannot estimate frequency or how the behavior was acquired.

text.zh: Mbeli Bai 长期监测资料给出的西部低地大猩猩雌性首次产仔平均年龄为 12.2 ± 0.6 岁（7 只雌性）；平均产间隔为 5.4 ± 0.9 年（54 个间隔，分析仅纳入幼体存活至 3 岁的间隔）。这些统计来自刚果共和国的一个研究地点和特定分析子集，不是所有种群的固定参数。
text.en: At Mbeli Bai, long-term records for western lowland gorillas gave a mean female age at first parturition of 12.2 ± 0.6 years (7 females) and a mean interbirth interval of 5.4 ± 0.9 years (54 intervals; the analysis included intervals whose offspring survived to age three). These estimates describe one study population and defined subsets, not fixed values for all populations.

scope.en: One habituated western lowland gorilla group at Loango National Park, Gabon, January 2018–July 2020; feeding values are scan-based.

text.zh: 一项雌性大猩猩比较研究报告，山地大猩猩在 Virunga 的首次产仔平均年龄为 10.1 ± 1.7 岁（56 只雌性），在 Bwindi 为 10.5 ± 1.3 岁（10 只）。两地比较未达到统计显著（p = 0.55）；这并不证明两种群完全等同，也没有覆盖 Grauer 大猩猩或东部大猩猩的所有种群。
text.en: A comparative study reported a mean age at first parturition of 10.1 ± 1.7 years for mountain gorillas in Virunga (56 females) and 10.5 ± 1.3 years in Bwindi (10 females). The difference was not statistically significant (p = 0.55); this does not demonstrate equivalence and does not cover Grauer's gorillas or every Eastern gorilla population.

text.zh: 针对 Grauer 大猩猩的线粒体基因组比较中，历史样本有 20 种单倍型，现代样本有 11 种；作者报告现代样本的单倍型和核苷酸多样性较低。样本由 68 只历史个体和 29 只现代个体组成，代表线粒体标记而非核基因组；作者将变化解释为外围种群消失的结果，但这一推断限于所用样本和模型。
text.en: In a mitochondrial-genome comparison focused on Grauer's gorillas, historical samples had 20 haplotypes and modern samples had 11; the authors reported lower haplotype and nucleotide diversity in the modern sample. The comparison included 68 historical and 29 modern individuals. It uses mitochondrial markers, not nuclear genomes; the authors attributed the change to peripheral-population loss, an inference bounded to their samples and model.

text.zh: 山地大猩猩生活史研究涉及 Virunga 火山山地和乌干达 Bwindi；Grauer 大猩猩遗传研究比较了历史博物馆材料与刚果民主共和国 Nkuba、Kahuzi-Biega 等地的现代样本。它们提供的是研究地点和采样史，不是一份覆盖东部大猩猩完整现今分布区的调查。
text.en: Mountain-gorilla life-history research covered the Virunga volcanoes and Bwindi in Uganda. The Grauer's gorilla genetic study compared historical museum material with modern samples from places including Nkuba and Kahuzi-Biega in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. These are research sites and sampling histories, not a complete survey of the Eastern gorilla's current range.

text.zh: 在墨西哥 Los Tuxtlas，研究者于 2000–2011 年每月调查十个吼猴群体，共 454 次群体访问。监测种群整体相对稳定，个体总数有所增加；作者推断大多数后来产仔的受孕发生在 4–6 月，断奶高峰在 4–5 月。这里的季节模式来自受研究的墨西哥亚种种群，不能当作全物种的固定繁殖周期。
text.en: At Los Tuxtlas in Mexico, researchers visited ten howler-monkey groups monthly from 2000 to 2011, making 454 group visits. The monitored population remained relatively stable overall while total individuals increased. The authors inferred that most conceptions leading to births occurred from April to June, with weaning peaking in April–May. These seasonal patterns come from the studied Mexican subspecies population, not a fixed species-wide cycle.

text.zh: 尼加拉瓜 Ometepe 岛两群成年吼猴的夜间睡眠记录中，55 条披风吼猴记录有 54 条采用坐姿（98.2%）；76.4% 位于水平基底，83.6% 位于大树枝上。观察来自 2003–2004 年和 2006 年的特定夜晚与群体，不能据此估计全物种比例。
text.en: Among night-time sleep records for two adult howler groups on Ometepe Island, Nicaragua, 54 of 55 mantled-howler records used a sit-in posture (98.2%); 76.4% were on horizontal substrates and 83.6% on large branches. Observations came from particular groups and nights in 2003–2004 and 2006, so they do not estimate species-wide proportions.

text.zh: 一项比较食物探索行为的研究中，披风吼猴对共同食用植物的嗅闻频率约为白面卷尾猴（Cebus imitator）的三倍，但低于杰氏蜘蛛猴。该比较使用研究地点所观察到的个体和食物；不同地点的研究记录并未建立物种普遍的嗅觉机制或日常频率。
text.en: In a comparative study of food investigation, mantled howlers sniffed shared food plants about three times as often as white-faced capuchins (Cebus imitator), but less often than Geoffroy's spider monkeys. The comparison uses animals and foods observed at study sites; records from those sites do not establish a species-wide sensory mechanism or everyday rate.

text.zh: 在西加里曼丹 Gunung Palung 国家公园，2009–2014 年的研究记录显示，四只长颊雄性猩猩共生育五只后代。更广的 2008–2019 年样本中，七只后代有五只确定了父亲；这些是单个完全野生种群的亲子鉴定结果，不是整个物种的繁殖率。
text.en: At Gunung Palung National Park in West Kalimantan, records from 2009–2014 showed that four flanged males sired five offspring. In the broader 2008–2019 sample, paternity was assigned for five of seven offspring. These are paternity results from one completely wild population, not a species-wide reproductive rate.

text.zh: Danau Sentarum 国家公园及周边的巢穴样线调查使用更新后的巢穴衰减率建模估算猩猩数量：公园内约 202 只（95% CI 75.67–541.79），园外约 71 只（95% CI 20.76–244.63）。这是基于巢穴记录和模型的地方估计，不是直接清点；结果对衰减率和调查地点敏感。
text.en: Nest transects in and around Danau Sentarum National Park used an updated nest-decay rate to model orangutan numbers: about 202 inside the park (95% CI 75.67–541.79) and about 71 outside it (95% CI 20.76–244.63). These are local model estimates from nest records, not direct counts, and depend on decay-rate assumptions and survey locations.

text.zh: Camp Leakey 曾接收被重新安置的猩猩。线粒体研究发现，代表创始谱系的 11 个样本中，9 个与当地 P. p. wurmbii 支系聚类，另有两只雌性与西加里曼丹北部或砂拉越的 P. p. pygmaeus 聚类；两只都曾与当地雄性交配。研究记录的是一个人为转移地点的谱系混合历史，不是自然分布区内全物种的基因流估计。
text.en: Camp Leakey received orangutans that had been reintroduced after displacement. A mitochondrial study found that, among 11 profiles representing founder lineages, nine clustered with the local P. p. wurmbii lineage, while two females clustered with P. p. pygmaeus from northern West Kalimantan or Sarawak; both reproduced with local males. This documents lineage mixing at one human-mediated release site, not gene flow across the species' natural range.

text.zh: 在毛里求斯 Mt Calebasses，一个 19–23 只的长尾猕猴群体于 2019 年 12 月至 2020 年 12 月接受观察。高果期月均家域为 10.6 ± 3.0 公顷，其他月份为 17.8 ± 5.6 公顷；月家域与果实可获得量负相关（r = −0.65，调整后 p = 0.037）。这是单个引入种群的一年记录，不是原生分布区的物种平均值。
text.en: At Mt Calebasses, Mauritius, one group of 19–23 long-tailed macaques was observed from December 2019 to December 2020. Mean monthly home range was 10.6 ± 3.0 hectares during the high-fruit period and 17.8 ± 5.6 hectares outside it; monthly range was negatively correlated with fruit availability (r = −0.65, adjusted p = 0.037). This is a one-year record from one introduced group, not a species mean from the native range.

text.zh: 同一毛里求斯群体的植物取食扫描中，入侵植物占 98%，果实取食扫描中占 97%；记录的果食主要来自入侵的 Litsea（40.2%）、Psidium cattleyanum（39.3%）和 Flacourtia indica（9.5%）。作者讨论了猕猴可能影响种子传播，但研究没有测量种子萌发、幼苗补充或实际植物入侵率。
text.en: In plant-feeding scans of the same Mauritius group, invasive plants accounted for 98% of records and 97% of fruit-feeding scans. Recorded fruit feeding was concentrated in invasive Litsea (40.2%), Psidium cattleyanum (39.3%) and Flacourtia indica (9.5%). The authors discuss possible seed-dispersal effects, but the study did not measure germination, seedling recruitment or realized plant-invasion rates.

text.zh: 一项微型 CT 与几何形态测量研究比较了 13 颗长尾猕猴下颌第二臼齿。带副牙尖的臼齿体积较大、相对牙尖较短，牙冠边缘副尖的出现也与主要牙尖更居中相关；作者认为结果总体符合牙尖发育级联模型，但该模型不能解释样本中的所有副尖形态。样本来自单一灵长类中心收藏。
text.en: A micro-CT and geometric-morphometric study compared 13 long-tailed macaque mandibular second molars. Molars with accessory cusps were larger and had shorter relative cusp heights, while peripheral-cusp presence was associated with more centrally positioned primary cusps. The pattern broadly fit the patterning-cascade model, but the model did not explain every accessory-cusp form in the sample, which came from one primate-centre collection.

text.zh: 一项恒河猴与长尾猕猴全基因组比较报告了 184 个与强化选择相关模式一致的候选基因，并发现 Y 染色体从恒河猴向长尾猕猴种群渗入的信号。作者将结果描述为与强化形成物种隔离的模型相容，而不是对该模型的证明；这也不是完整的物种系统树。
text.en: A whole-genome comparison of rhesus and long-tailed macaque samples reported 184 candidate genes consistent with reinforcement-related patterns and a signal of Y-chromosome introgression from rhesus into long-tailed macaque populations. The authors described the findings as consistent with a model of reinforcement, not proof of it; the study is not a complete species phylogeny.

sources.title: Reinegger et al. (2023) — Foraging strategies of invasive Macaca fascicularis in Mauritius

scope.zh: 毛里求斯 Mt Calebasses 一个自由活动引入群体，2019 年 12 月至 2020 年 12 月；不是原生分布区调查。
scope.en: One free-ranging introduced group at Mt Calebasses, Mauritius, December 2019–December 2020; not a native-range survey.

sources.title: Chapple, Smith & Skinner (2024) — Cusp development in Macaca fascicularis mandibular molars

scope.zh: 单一灵长类中心收藏的 13 颗下颌第二臼齿微型 CT 与几何形态测量样本。
scope.en: Micro-CT and geometric-morphometric sample of 13 mandibular second molars from one primate-centre collection.

sources.title: Bailey et al. (2023) — Genomic analysis of rhesus and cynomolgus macaques

scope.zh: 恒河猴和长尾猕猴异域与同域群体的比较全基因组分析；结果与强化选择模型相容，但不构成证明。
scope.en: Comparative whole-genome analysis of allopatric and parapatric rhesus and cynomolgus groups; results are consistent with, but do not prove, a reinforcement model.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。本文的主要生态材料来自毛里求斯一个引入群体，不能代表原生范围的典型饮食或家域。牙齿研究使用 13 颗标本，全基因组结论取决于异域与同域样本及其模型；均不是全物种综合。
limitations.en: The main ecological evidence comes from one introduced group in Mauritius and does not represent typical diet or home range across the native range. Dental findings use 13 specimens, and genomic conclusions depend on allopatric and parapatric samples and their models; none is a complete species synthesis. Source-linked and not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 哥斯达黎加 Osa 半岛的研究比较了蜘蛛猴睡眠地点周围的种子堆积区与对照地点。相机记录了脊椎动物到访，样点调查报告这些地点的幼苗数量和粪甲虫生物量较高。这些结果涉及所采样的林地和生态指标，不能直接推断整片雨林的更新速率或所有蜘蛛猴的作用。
text.en: A study on Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula compared seed-laden latrine sites near spider-monkey sleeping locations with control sites. Camera traps recorded vertebrate visits, and sampling reported higher seedling abundance and dung-beetle biomass at those sites. The results concern sampled forest sites and indicators; they do not directly estimate forest-wide regeneration or the effects of all spider monkeys.

text.zh: 巴拿馬 Barro Colorado 島的一項追蹤研究分析了一只亚成体雌性杰氏蜘蛛猴六个月的移动记录。她选择的移动步段与树冠高度、距 8 米冠层空隙的距离和树冠厚度正相关；模型交叉验证平均 Spearman 相关系数为 0.94。这是一个体的模型结果，不是物种普遍的移动偏好。
text.en: At Barro Colorado Island in Panama, a tracking study analyzed six months of movement by one subadult female Geoffroy's spider monkey. Selected movement steps were positively associated with canopy height, distance from canopy gaps using an 8-metre cutoff, and crown thickness. The model's mean cross-validation Spearman correlation was 0.94; this is an individual model result, not a species-wide movement preference.

text.zh: 在比较果实探索行为的研究样本中，杰氏蜘蛛猴的嗅闻频率在三种灵长类中最高，高于白面卷尾猴和披风吼猴。研究还比较了鼻甲表面积，但其 15 件杰氏蜘蛛猴头骨样本没有报告具体地理来源、采集时间或野生/圈养状态，因此解剖差异不能解释成全物种变异。
text.en: In the study's sample of fruit-investigation behavior, Geoffroy's spider monkeys had the highest sniffing rate among the three primates studied, above white-faced capuchins and mantled howlers. The study also compared nasal-turbinate area, but geographic provenance, collection dates and wild or captive status were not reported for its 15 spider-monkey skulls, so the anatomical sample does not describe species-wide variation.

sources.title: Whitworth et al. (2019) — Spider-monkey sleeping sites influence rainforest heterogeneity

scope.zh: 哥斯达黎加 Osa 半岛的杰氏蜘蛛猴睡眠地点及其周边样点；结果限于采样地点和所测指标。
scope.en: Geoffroy's spider-monkey sleeping sites and surrounding samples on Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula; results are limited to sampled sites and measured indicators.

sources.title: McLean et al. (2016) — Movement and LiDAR-estimated canopy structure in arboreal primates

scope.zh: 巴拿馬 Barro Colorado 島一只亚成体雌性杰氏蜘蛛猴，2011 年追踪六个月；不是物种层面移动估计。
scope.en: One subadult female Geoffroy's spider monkey tracked for six months in 2011 at Barro Colorado Island, Panama; not a species-level movement estimate.

sources.title: Melin et al. (2022) — Anatomy and dietary specialization influence sensory behaviour among sympatric primates

scope.zh: 野外食物探索行为和博物馆头骨比较；头骨样本来源信息有限，行为结论限于研究样本。
scope.en: Field observations of food investigation and museum skull comparisons; skull provenance is limited and behavioral results are sample-bounded.

limitations.en: This introduction combines sleeping-site, single-individual movement and comparative food-investigation studies. Sites, individuals and measures differ across the research; nasal-turbinate specimen provenance is unknown, and an individual movement model is not a population-level habitat-use study. Source-linked and not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 在马达加斯加 Kirindy 森林，研究者追踪了 2017、2018 两个繁殖季的 12 只野生幼体，观察母体孕期粪便糖皮质激素代谢物与幼体早期发育。母体指标较高的幼体呈现较快生长、较早独立觅食和玩耍的关联；2018 年队列未跟踪完整六个月。该观察性研究不能证明母体压力造成这些差异。
text.en: At Kirindy Forest in Madagascar, researchers followed 12 wild infants from the 2017 and 2018 breeding seasons and compared maternal prenatal fecal glucocorticoid metabolites with early development. Higher maternal values were associated with faster growth and earlier independent foraging and play. The 2018 cohort was not followed for a full six months, and this observational study does not show that maternal stress caused the differences.

text.zh: 在西南马达加斯加 Kirindy Mitea 国家公园，一个野生种群的 M/LWS opsin 基因型显示与多态三色视觉相符的变异。含三色视觉基因型个体的群体中，个体体重指数和取食果实的时间、单次果食持续时间较高。基因型是视觉表型的代理指标；作者提出的旱季找果优势仍是待检验假说。
text.en: At Kirindy Mitea National Park in southwestern Madagascar, M/LWS opsin genotypes in one wild population showed variation consistent with polymorphic trichromacy. Individuals in groups containing trichromats had higher body-mass indices and more fruit-feeding time, with longer fruit-feeding bouts. Genotype is a proxy for visual phenotype; the proposed dry-season fruit-detection advantage remains a hypothesis.

text.zh: Kirindy 的同一类野外研究中，母体粪便糖皮质激素代谢物在低降雨时段和孕晚期较高。作者把降雨作为当地食物可获得性的代理变量；这一关联限于受监测母体、地点和两个繁殖季，不能定义物种的气候适生范围或证明因果关系。
text.en: In the same field research at Kirindy, maternal fecal glucocorticoid metabolites were higher during low-rainfall periods and late pregnancy. The authors used rainfall as a local proxy for food availability. This association is limited to monitored mothers, the site and two breeding seasons; it does not define the species' climate niche or establish causation.

sources.title: Malalaharivony et al. (2021) — Maternal stress effects on infant development in wild Verreaux's sifaka

scope.zh: 马达加斯加中西部 Kirindy Forest/CNFEREF 两个繁殖季的 12 只野生幼体和母体观察；队列跟踪时间不同。
scope.en: Observations of 12 wild infants and mothers across two breeding seasons at Kirindy Forest/CNFEREF, central-western Madagascar; cohort follow-up differed.

sources.title: Veilleux et al. (2016) — Group benefit associated with polymorphic trichromacy in Verreaux's sifaka

scope.zh: 马达加斯加 Kirindy Mitea 国家公园一个野生种群的视觉基因型和取食观察；基因型不是视网膜解剖测量。
scope.en: Visual-genotype and feeding observations from one wild population at Kirindy Mitea National Park, Madagascar; genotype is not a retinal anatomical measurement.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。这是关于两个马达加斯加研究地点的专题入门页，不是韦氏冕狐猴完整物种综述。幼体研究的队列随访不完全相同；视力结论来自基因型代理与局部取食样本，作者提出的季节性优势不是已证实的普遍功能。
limitations.en: This is a focused introduction to studies at two Madagascar sites, not a complete review of Verreaux's sifaka. Infant cohorts had different follow-up windows; visual findings rely on genotype proxies and local feeding samples, and the proposed seasonal advantage is not established as a general function. Source-linked and not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 在马来西亚半岛的 Pasoh Forest Reserve 与 Belum–Temengor 森林综合体，照相机陷阱占域模型显示，Pasoh 的皆伐与局部灭绝概率升高相联系；Belum–Temengor 的选择性采伐区与未受干扰区之间则没有检出明确的占域差异。结论来自两个研究景观及其模型，不能当作该种对所有林业活动的普遍响应。
text.en: Camera-trap occupancy models from Pasoh Forest Reserve and the Belum–Temengor Forest Complex in Peninsular Malaysia linked clear-cutting at Pasoh with higher local-extinction probability. At Belum–Temengor, the study detected no clear occupancy difference between selectively logged and undisturbed areas. These results belong to two study landscapes and their models, not a general response to every form of forestry.

sources.title: Holzner et al. (2021) — Occupancy of wild southern pig-tailed macaques in intact and degraded forests in Peninsular Malaysia

scope.zh: 马来西亚半岛 Pasoh Forest Reserve（2013–2017）和 Belum–Temengor 森林综合体的照相机陷阱占域研究；结论限于所采样地点和拟合模型。
scope.en: Camera-trap occupancy study at Pasoh Forest Reserve (2013–2017) and the Belum–Temengor Forest Complex in Peninsular Malaysia; findings are limited to sampled sites and fitted models.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。这是关于两个马来西亚研究景观的占域研究导读，不是南豚尾猕猴完整生态综述；局部占域模型不能代表该种全部分布区或所有采伐类型。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This is a guide to occupancy research in two Malaysian landscapes, not a complete ecological review of the southern pig-tailed macaque; local occupancy models do not represent the full range or every logging regime.

text.zh: 马达加斯加 Maromizaha 森林的一项纵向研究追踪了 8 个家庭群中的 8 只野生幼体。母体背负在最小年龄组较常见，随幼体活动能力增加而下降；与母体以外群体成员的玩耍和梳理首次记录于 128 日龄。研究样本中，唱叫只见于 16–20 个月组；这些观察不能代表全物种发育差异。
text.en: A longitudinal study at Maromizaha Forest, Madagascar, followed eight wild infants from eight family groups. Maternal carrying was frequent in the youngest sampled class and declined as locomotion increased; play and grooming with non-maternal group members were first recorded at 128 days. Singing appeared only in the 16–20-month class in this sample, which cannot represent species-wide developmental variation.

text.zh: 同一研究记录的四个幼体年龄组都以叶片为最常消耗的食物；果实占 0–3 个月组取食时间的 15.14%，在 4–7 个月组为 27.09%。作者共记录 18 个植物科，并观察到母子共同取食比例随幼体年龄下降。这是单一森林中幼体样本的取食资料，不是完整物种食谱。
text.en: Leaves were the most consumed food in all four sampled infant age classes. Fruit made up 15.14% of feeding time in the 0–3-month class and 27.09% in the 4–7-month class. Across the study, the authors recorded foods from 18 plant families and found that mother–offspring co-feeding declined with infant age. These are feeding observations from young indris at one forest, not a complete species diet.

sources.title: Brunod et al. (2025) — Ontogeny of Diet and Behavior of a Wild, Critically Endangered Lemur (Indri indri)

scope.zh: 马达加斯加 Maromizaha 森林 8 个野生幼体及其家庭群；观察期为 2022–2023 年，年龄组与随访时间有限。
scope.en: Eight wild infants and their family groups at Maromizaha Forest, Madagascar; observations ran from 2022–2023 and covered a limited set of age classes and follow-up windows.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。本文是 Maromizaha 一处森林中幼体发育与取食研究导读；8 只幼体和缺少的 8–9 个月年龄组不支持推断全物种、全年或不同地区的普遍规律。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This guide covers infant development and feeding at one Maromizaha forest site; eight infants and a missing 8–9-month age class do not establish species-wide, year-round or range-wide patterns.

text.zh: 北苏拉威西 Tangkoko 保护区一项长期研究监测了 41 种树木的物候，并用 4 个已习惯化群体估算家域。月均估值为 2.32 平方公里（标准差 1.12）；模型中月均气温是最受支持的预测因子，较高气温与较大月家域相关。论文摘要报告 2,877 个移动追踪日，方法章的群体分项合计为 2,577 日；此差异未解决，结果也不是全物种或因果性气候效应。
text.en: At Tangkoko Reserve in North Sulawesi, a long-term study monitored phenology in 41 tree species and estimated home ranges for four habituated macaque groups. The monthly mean estimate was 2.32 km² (SD 1.12); monthly temperature was the best-supported predictor in the model, with higher temperatures associated with larger monthly ranges. The abstract reports 2,877 ranging days, while the Methods group subtotals sum to 2,577; this discrepancy is unresolved. The estimate is neither species-wide nor evidence of a causal climate effect.

text.zh: 2023 年 7–8 月的北马鲁古调查在 Bacan 记录到野生黑冠猕猴或其粪便的 18 个地点，在 Kasiruta 记录 4 处，在 Halmahera 南部记录 1 处。研究另在 Bacan 6 处记录 10 只宠物猕猴；调查未到 Mandioli，当地「未发现」资讯来自访谈，不是直接缺席调查。这些是抽样地点的记录，不构成完整分布图。
text.en: A July–August 2023 survey in North Maluku recorded wild crested macaques or their feces at 18 locations on Bacan, four on Kasiruta and one in southern Halmahera. It separately recorded ten pet macaques at six Bacan locations. The survey did not visit Mandioli; reports of no evidence there came from interviews, not a direct absence survey. These are records from sampled locations, not a complete range map.

sources.title: Joly et al. (2023) — Climate, Temporal Abundance of Key Food Sources and Home Ranges of Crested Macaques (Macaca nigra) in Sulawesi, Indonesia

scope.zh: 北苏拉威西 Tangkoko 保护区 2012–2020 年物候监测与 4 个已习惯化群体的家域估计；论文中追踪日总数有未解决差异。
scope.en: Phenology monitoring and home-range estimates for four habituated groups at Tangkoko Reserve, North Sulawesi, 2012–2020; the article contains an unresolved discrepancy in total ranging days.

sources.title: Neugebauer et al. (2025) — Distribution and Human-Mediated Establishment of Crested Macaque (Macaca nigra) Populations in the North Moluccas, Indonesia

scope.zh: 印尼北马鲁古 Bacan、Kasiruta、Mandioli 及 Halmahera 南部的 2023 年调查和访谈；Mandioli 未直接踏查。
scope.en: 2023 surveys and interviews on Bacan, Kasiruta, Mandioli and southern Halmahera, North Maluku, Indonesia; Mandioli was not directly surveyed.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。家域数值来自 Tangkoko 的 4 个群体且原文追踪日总数矛盾；北马鲁古记录属 2023 年局部调查。两项研究均不能代替完整现生分布或种群趋势评估。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The home-range estimate uses four Tangkoko groups and the paper reports conflicting ranging-day totals; North Maluku records come from a local 2023 survey. Neither study replaces a complete current range or population-trend assessment.

text.zh: 在刚果民主共和国 LuiKotale 的 Bompusa 野生社群，研究者用 23 只已知成年个体 2008–2010 年的毛发稳定同位素资料分析取食。雄性社会等级较低与较低的氮同位素值相关；雌性在不同繁殖状态中没有相同的等级关系。这类同位素测量反映取食生态，不会单独指出每只个体吃了哪种食物。
text.en: At the wild Bompusa community at LuiKotale, Democratic Republic of the Congo, researchers used stable isotopes in hair from 23 known adults sampled in 2008–2010. Lower social rank was associated with lower nitrogen-isotope values in males; females showed no corresponding rank relationship across reproductive states. Isotope measurements inform feeding ecology but do not by themselves identify each individual's exact foods.

text.zh: 另一项跨 Kokolopori 与 LuiKotale 两地的研究，分析了刚果民主共和国 4 个社群、53 只野生成体的 1,509 条已知发声者录音。监督式随机森林分类能可靠区分预先定义的 15 种叫声中的 11 种；仍有声学重叠，因此作者把发声谱系描述为渐变型。分类结果不等于叫声含义，也不是全分布区完整清单。
text.en: A separate study at Kokolopori and LuiKotale analyzed 1,509 known-caller vocalizations from 53 wild adults in four Democratic Republic of the Congo communities. Supervised random-forest classification reliably distinguished 11 of 15 predefined call types; acoustic overlap remained, so the authors described the repertoire as graded. Classification does not establish call meaning or provide a complete range-wide inventory.

sources.title: Oelze et al. (2016) — The Steady State Great Ape? Long Term Isotopic Records Reveal the Effects of Season, Social Rank and Reproductive Status on Bonobo Feeding Behavior

scope.zh: 刚果民主共和国 LuiKotale 附近 Bompusa 一个习惯化野生社群的毛发稳定同位素研究；样本代表 2008–2010 年。
scope.en: Stable-isotope study of hair from one habituated wild Bompusa community near LuiKotale, Democratic Republic of the Congo; samples represent 2008–2010.

sources.title: Wegdell et al. (2025) — An updated vocal repertoire of wild adult bonobos (Pan paniscus)

scope.zh: 刚果民主共和国 Kokolopori 与 LuiKotale 两处、4 个社群的成年倭黑猩猩叫声资料；包括 2011–2022 年录音。
scope.en: Adult bonobo vocalizations from four communities at Kokolopori and LuiKotale, Democratic Republic of the Congo, recorded during 2011–2022.

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The studies differ in communities, periods and methods; isotope data do not identify exact foods, and call classification does not establish meaning or the full state of the repertoire elsewhere.

text.zh: 加纳 Boabeng-Fiema 猴类保护区 2019 年的地面调查，在 6 片森林斑块记录到 34 群、共 602 只白腿疣猴。调查包含 17 条样线，总步行距离 71.05 公里；这是保护区内的样地清点，不是全球种群数量。
text.en: A 2019 ground survey at Boabeng-Fiema Monkey Sanctuary, Ghana, recorded 34 groups and 602 white-thighed colobus across six forest patches. The survey used 17 transects and covered 71.05 km on foot; this is a site-level count, not a global population estimate.

text.zh: 同一论文报告 Boabeng-Fiema 的估计密度在 2007 至 2019 年间上升 70%（年均 5.8%），但提醒两次调查由不同人员执行、方法也不同。因此这一比较不能当作方法一致或覆盖全分布区的种群趋势。
text.en: The same article reports a 70% increase in estimated density at Boabeng-Fiema between 2007 and 2019 (5.8% per year), while noting that survey personnel and methods differed. The comparison is not a methodologically uniform or range-wide population trend.

sources.title: Wiafe et al. (2023) — Current populations of Colobus vellerosus and Cercopithecus lowei and land-use, land cover changes in Boabeng-Fiema Monkey Sanctuary, Ghana

scope.zh: 加纳 Boabeng-Fiema 猴类保护区的地面调查与土地覆被研究；种群清点及 2007–2019 比较限于该地和文中调查方法。
scope.en: Ground survey and land-cover study at Boabeng-Fiema Monkey Sanctuary, Ghana; counts and the 2007–2019 comparison are limited to that site and the reported methods.

scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。资料集中于加纳一处保护区；2007 与 2019 年的估计密度受不同人员和方法影响，不能外推为全物种趋势。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The evidence concerns one Ghanaian sanctuary; density estimates from 2007 and 2019 used different personnel and methods and cannot establish a species-wide trend.

records.scientificName: Macaca munzala Sinha, Datta, Madhusudan & Mishra, 2005

text.zh: 一项以 Upper Subansiri 暂定种群为对象的线粒体 DNA 贝叶斯天际线分析，推断末次盛冰期后约 15,000 年前出现种群扩张。12 份旧狩猎战利品皮样本中有 10 份成功测序；这是单一地理种群的模型推断，不是普查数量，也不能代表全物种。
text.en: A mitochondrial-DNA Bayesian skyline analysis of a tentative Upper Subansiri population inferred expansion after the Last Glacial Maximum, around 15,000 years before present. Ten of twelve old hunting-trophy skin samples were successfully sequenced. This is a model inference for one geographic population, not a census or species-wide history.

text.zh: 同一研究的近似贝叶斯计算中，Upper Subansiri 暂定种群在约 3,500 年前的有效种群规模下降情景最符合模型，估计约缩小 30 倍。这是基于小样本与假设的历史有效种群推断；研究不能排除未采样迁入，也没有证明气候或人类活动造成变化。
text.en: In the same study's approximate Bayesian computation, a decline scenario for the tentative Upper Subansiri population best fit the model, estimating an approximately 30-fold reduction in effective population size around 3,500 years ago. This is a historical model inference based on a small sample and assumptions; unsampled migration could not be excluded, and climate or human causes were not established.

sources.title: Chakraborty et al. (2014) — Mixed Fortunes: Ancient Expansion and Recent Decline in Population Size of a Subtropical Montane Primate, the Arunachal Macaque Macaca munzala

scope.zh: 印度阿鲁纳恰尔邦三个暂定阿鲁纳恰尔猕猴种群的线粒体 DNA 与微卫星研究；文中此处只介绍 Upper Subansiri 样本及模型推断。
scope.en: Mitochondrial-DNA and microsatellite study of three tentative Arunachal macaque populations in India; this introduction uses only the Upper Subansiri sample and model inferences.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Both demographic accounts are model results for the same tentative population, not a census or species-wide reconstruction; historical effective size is not a current individual count.

text.zh: 越南 Cao Vit 长臂猿物种与栖地保护区及中国 Bangliang 自然保护区所在的跨境森林区块，一项结合声纹辨识、野外观察和长期监测记录的 2021 年调查，估计辨认出 11 个家庭群、共 74 只高北白颊长臂猿。作者认为旧估计高出 38% 主要源于重复计群，并未发现种群下降证据；估计不含数量未知的独居扩散个体，也不涵盖其历史分布区。
text.en: A 2021 survey of the transboundary forest block spanning Cao Vit Gibbon Species and Habitat Conservation Area in Vietnam and Bangliang Nature Reserve in China combined vocal fingerprinting, field observations and long-term monitoring records. It identified 11 family groups and estimated 74 Cao Vit gibbons. The authors attributed a 38% difference from an older estimate mainly to duplicate group counts and reported no evidence of decline. The estimate excludes an unknown number of solitary dispersers and does not cover the former range.

sources.title: Wearn et al. (2024) — Vocal fingerprinting reveals a substantially smaller global population of the Critically Endangered cao vit gibbon (Nomascus nasutus) than previously thought

scope.zh: 越南与中国相邻保护区内一片跨境残存森林的调查；声学资料于 2021 年 9–10 月采集，结果限于该林区。
scope.en: Survey of one transboundary remnant forest block in adjacent Vietnamese and Chinese reserves; acoustic data were collected in September–October 2021 and results are limited to that block.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。这是对一片跨境残存林区的种群估计，且未计入数量未知的独居扩散者；不能把它解读为所有历史或可能分布点的普查。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This is a population estimate for one transboundary remnant forest block that excludes an unknown number of solitary dispersers; it is not a census of all former or possible sites.

text.zh: 印尼西爪哇 Cikananga 野生动物中心的一项人工喂食实验，让 22 只曾遭捕获、后被救助的成年大懒猴参与 75 次猎物呈现试验，记录到 5 次舔舐上臂腺，其中 4 次发生在理毛时。唯一一次非理毛观察中，一只雄性靠近毛毛虫后退到栖架上舔腺，并未试图捕捉毛毛虫。这是救助中心笼养情境，不能说明野外捕食时如何使用毒液。
text.en: At Cikananga Wildlife Center in West Java, Indonesia, researchers presented prey in 75 trials to 22 rescued adult greater slow lorises that had been captured from the wild. They recorded brachial-gland licking five times, four during grooming. In the sole non-grooming observation, a male approached a caterpillar, withdrew to a perch and licked the gland without trying to catch it. This captive rescue-center study does not show how wild lorises use venom during prey capture.

sources.title: Fuller, Wirdateti & Nekaris (2024) — Evaluating the Use of Chemical Weapons for Capturing Prey by a Venomous Mammal, the Greater Slow Loris (Nycticebus coucang)

scope.zh: 印尼西爪哇 Cikananga 野生动物中心 22 只曾遭捕获的救助成年懒猴；75 次人工猎物呈现试验在 2014 年进行，并非野外观察。
scope.en: Seventy-five artificial prey-presentation trials with 22 rescued, formerly wild-caught adult lorises at Cikananga Wildlife Center, West Java, Indonesia, in 2014; not field observations.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。本文只介绍一项救助中心的笼内猎物呈现试验；样本原为野外捕获但试验非野外观察，不能外推野外行为频率或捕食机制。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This guide covers one rescue-center prey-presentation experiment; the subjects were originally wild-caught, but the trials were captive and do not establish wild behavior frequency or prey-capture mechanisms.

records.scientificName: Mico acariensis (M. van Roosmalen, T. van Roosmalen, Mittermeier & Rylands, 2000)

text.zh: 一篇 2023 年的亚马逊南中部调查，根据两处既有地点与三处新地点，将阿卡里绒猴的报告分布界定在 Acarí 河右岸、Sucundurí 河左岸及 BR-230 以南，面积约 17,480 平方公里。这是从已报告出现点推得的区域范围，不是完整普查，也不估算当前数量。
text.en: A 2023 south-central Amazonia account used two previously reported localities and three new ones to delineate the reported range of the Acarí marmoset between the right bank of the Acarí River, the left bank of the Sucundurí River and areas south of BR-230, about 17,480 km². This is a regional inference from occurrence records, not a complete survey or current abundance estimate.

text.zh: 同一论文根据地点资料和区域地形提出假说：Acarí 河源头可能是阿卡里绒猴、Mico chrysoleucos 与 M. melanurus 的接触区，并可能发生杂交。作者没有报告已观察到的杂交个体或基因交流，并指出仍需调查、标本与样本来确认接触区是否存在。
text.en: The same paper proposed from locality records and regional geomorphology that the Acarí River headwaters might be a contact zone for the Acarí marmoset, Mico chrysoleucos and M. melanurus, where hybridization could occur. It did not report observed hybrids or gene flow; the authors called for further surveys, specimens and samples to establish whether the contact zone exists.

sources.title: Costa-Araújo et al. (2023) — Notes on the distribution and habitat use of marmosets (Callitrichidae: Mico) from south-central Amazonia

scope.zh: 巴西亚马逊南中部的绒猴地点记录、分布界定与栖地研究；范围及接触区是作者根据区域记录提出的解释。
scope.en: Marmoset locality records, range delineation and habitat study in south-central Amazonia, Brazil; range and contact-zone statements are the authors' interpretations of regional records.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。分布范围是少量出现记录支持的区域界定；可能的接触区和杂交仍是作者假说，没有证实的杂交或基因交流记录。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The range is a regional delineation based on a few occurrence records; the possible contact zone and hybridization remain hypotheses without documented hybrids or gene flow.

text.zh: 马达加斯加西部 Menabe Central 的样线研究，在未退化森林的旱季记录到伯特氏鼠狐猴与灰鼠狐猴（Microcebus murinus）沿样线分布呈显著负相关（ISIA T = −0.13，p = 0.013）。调查于 2003–2007 年进行，涵盖 34 条一公里样线，记录到 786 次鼠狐猴目击，其中伯特氏鼠狐猴 92 次。这个局部季节与栖地模式不能证明竞争，也不代表其他地区或季节。
text.en: A transect study in Menabe Central, western Madagascar, found a significant negative within-transect association between Madame Berthe's mouse lemur and the gray mouse lemur (Microcebus murinus) in non-degraded forest during the dry season (ISIA T = −0.13, p = 0.013). Surveys ran from 2003–2007 on 34 one-kilometre transects, with 786 mouse-lemur sightings, including 92 M. berthae. This local habitat-season pattern does not prove competition or represent other seasons and sites.

sources.title: Schäffler, Kappeler & Halley (2021) — Mouse Lemurs in an Assemblage of Cheirogaleid Primates in Menabe Central, Western Madagascar: Three Reasons to Coexist

scope.zh: 马达加斯加西部 Menabe Central 四种狐猴的夜间样线研究；结果限于报告的地点、季节和生境情境。
scope.en: Nocturnal transect study of four cheirogaleid species in Menabe Central, western Madagascar; findings are limited to reported sites, seasons and habitat scenarios.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。介绍只涵盖 Menabe Central 未退化森林旱季的一项样线结果；空间负相关不是竞争的直接证明，也不能外推到其他栖地季节。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This guide covers one transect result from non-degraded Menabe Central forest in the dry season; negative spatial association is not direct proof of competition and does not generalize across habitats or seasons.

text.zh: 一项比较 10 种长臂猿的 Y 染色体研究纳入 26 只圈养雄性个体，其中敏捷长臂猿有 3 只。由 7 个扩增片段拼接出的树未能区分敏捷长臂猿、爪哇长臂猿与克氏长臂猿，形成未解析的三分支；作者指出节点支持偏弱、Y 染色体变异不足。这是父系标记的有限结果，不是完整物种树。
text.en: A Y-chromosome comparison of ten gibbon species included 26 captive males, three of them agile gibbons. The tree built from seven concatenated amplicons left H. agilis, the silvery gibbon and the Kloss's gibbon in an unresolved trichotomy; the authors noted weak support and insufficient Y-chromosome variation. This is a limited paternal-marker result, not a complete species tree.

text.zh: 另一项长臂猿视蛋白基因研究收集了 37 份敏捷长臂猿血样，来源包括印度尼西亚、泰国的动物园及加里曼丹居民饲养的个体；其中两份未进入视蛋白分型。研究报告雄性敏捷长臂猿样本中 L/M 视蛋白基因转换片段主要位于内含子。它分析的是基因序列，没有测试动物的色觉行为，也不能推断该变异在整个物种中的比例。
text.en: A separate gibbon opsin study collected blood from 37 agile gibbons at zoos in Indonesia and Thailand and from animals kept by local residents in Kalimantan; two samples were excluded from opsin genotyping. In male H. agilis samples, detected L/M opsin gene-conversion tracts were mostly in introns. The study analyzed gene sequences, not color-vision behavior, and does not establish species-wide prevalence.

sources.title: Chan et al. (2012) — A comparative analysis of Y chromosome and mtDNA phylogenies of the Hylobates gibbons

scope.zh: 长臂猿 Y 染色体与线粒体标记比较；本文只转述敏捷长臂猿三个样本在 Y 染色体树中的未解析位置。
scope.en: Comparison of gibbon Y-chromosome and mitochondrial markers; this account uses only the unresolved placement of three H. agilis samples in the Y-chromosome tree.

sources.title: Hiwatashi et al. (2011) — Gene conversion and purifying selection shape nucleotide variation in gibbon L/M opsin genes

scope.zh: 多种长臂猿的视蛋白基因序列比较；敏捷长臂猿结论限于所采集样本，研究未测试行为性色觉。
scope.en: Opsin-sequence comparison across gibbons; H. agilis findings are limited to sampled animals, and the study did not test behavioral color vision.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。两项研究分别考察有限 Y 染色体标记和视蛋白序列；它们不构成完整的系统发育、感官或野外生态综述。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The two studies concern limited Y-chromosome markers and opsin sequences; together they are not a complete phylogenetic, sensory or field-ecology review.

text.zh: 泰国考艾国家公园的一项近距离叫声研究，从 14 只雄性和 11 只雌性提取了 462 个 “hoo” 叫声。在样本足够的情境间，叫声声学参数有所不同；例如，猛禽情境叫声的峰频和低频低于二重唱叫声。作者指出仍需播放实验，才能检验听者是否分辨这些变体。
text.en: A close-range call study at Khao Yai National Park, Thailand, analyzed 462 “hoo” calls from 14 males and 11 females. Acoustic parameters differed among adequately sampled contexts; for example, raptor-context calls had lower peak and low frequencies than duet calls. The authors noted that playback tests were still needed to determine whether listeners distinguish these variants.

text.zh: 同一公园的 12 次播放实验涉及 6 个习惯化群体。播放二重唱录音后，5 个群体跟唱；播放捕食者叫声则引起反捕食反应，没有引出二重唱。这表明这些群体在该实验流程下对不同录音作出不同反应，不能由此概括自然叫声的全部功能。
text.en: Twelve playback trials at the same park involved six habituated groups. Five groups counter-sang after duet-song playback; predator-song playback elicited antipredator responses but no duet singing. The groups responded differently to these recordings under the experiment's protocol, which does not establish the functions of the full natural call repertoire.

sources.title: Clarke, Reichard & Zuberbühler (2015) — Context-specific close-range ‘hoo’ calls in wild gibbons (Hylobates lar)

scope.zh: 泰国考艾国家公园一处研究点的近距离叫声记录；分析仅包括样本充足的情境。
scope.en: Close-range call recordings from one study site in Khao Yai National Park, Thailand; analyses include only adequately sampled contexts.

sources.title: Andrieu et al. (2020) — Song discrimination and antipredator responses in white-handed gibbons (Hylobates lar)

scope.zh: 考艾国家公园 6 个习惯化群体的 12 次播放实验；结论限于所用录音和实验流程。
scope.en: Twelve playback trials with six habituated groups at Khao Yai National Park; findings are limited to the recordings and experimental protocol used.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。两项研究都来自泰国考艾国家公园的有限样本，播放实验仅有 12 次；不能据此代表其他种群、完整叫声谱或全物种生态。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Both studies use bounded samples from Khao Yai National Park in Thailand, and the playback experiment comprised only twelve trials; they do not represent other populations, the full call repertoire or the species' ecology as a whole.

text.zh: 连接印度迈索尔的公路沿线调查报告，冠猕猴计数从 2003 年的 889 只降至 2015 年的 407 只，约为早期计数的 46%。2015 年 1–2 月的复查覆盖 464 公里，道路中心线两侧各 15 米计入路边样带。这个结果描述特定道路样带的变化，不是物种整体数量估计，也不能单独证明下降原因。
text.en: A roadside survey along routes connecting Mysore, India, reported 889 bonnet macaques in 2003 and 407 in 2015, about 46% of the earlier count. The January–February 2015 resurvey covered 464 km, counting strips within 15 m of each side of the road centre. This describes change along specific roadside strips, not total species abundance, and does not by itself establish the cause of decline.

text.zh: 在喀拉拉邦 Parambikulam 景观，研究者于 64 个网格中 33 格记录到 54 个冠猕猴群。单季占域模型估计平均网格占域率为 0.51±0.08，探测概率为 0.25±0.05。模型值对应这一处森林调查及其采样设计，不能等同于全物种分布或数量。
text.en: In the Parambikulam landscape of Kerala, researchers detected 54 bonnet macaque groups in 33 of 64 grid cells. A single-season occupancy model estimated mean cell occupancy at 0.51±0.08 and detection probability at 0.25±0.05. These modelled values belong to one forest survey and its sampling design; they are not a range-wide distribution or abundance estimate.

text.zh: 一项涵盖 12 种猕猴、711 件博物馆标本的颅齿比较，将冠猕猴列入较接近赤道、总体颅齿尺寸偏小的类群。表中有 79 件冠猕猴标本，来自印度南部和西部；样本包含亚成体，也有少数来源不明或圈养个体。该种间比较不能说明种内地理差异或单独诊断特征。
text.en: A craniodental comparison of twelve macaque species and 711 museum specimens placed the bonnet macaque among near-equatorial species tending toward smaller overall craniodental size. The table lists 79 M. radiata specimens from South and West India; the sample includes subadults and a few captive or unprovenanced specimens. This interspecific comparison does not establish variation within the species or diagnostic traits.

text.zh: 2017 年研究依据南印度若干道路、寺庙和旅游地点的局部记录，建议考虑把部分植被丘陵及人类活动地点纳入保护地。它是研究者提出的规划建议，不代表已经法定设立保护区，也不是当前保育等级或全分布区恢复方案。
text.en: Using local records from roads, temples and tourist sites in southern India, a 2017 study proposed considering some vegetated hillocks and human-use locations as conservation reserves. This was a research recommendation, not evidence that statutory reserves were established, a current conservation category or a range-wide recovery plan.

sources.title: Erinjery et al. (2017) — Losing its ground: A case study of fast declining populations of a ‘least-concern’ species, the bonnet macaque (Macaca radiata)

scope.zh: 南印度多个道路、森林和人类活动地点的 2017 年研究；计数、占域模型及规划建议各自限于其局部样点。
scope.en: A 2017 study of roadside, forest and human-use sites in southern India; counts, occupancy models and planning suggestions retain their distinct local sampling limits.

sources.title: Grunstra et al. (2018) — A multivariate ecogeographic analysis of macaque craniodental variation

scope.zh: 跨 12 种猕猴的博物馆颅齿比较；冠猕猴样本来自研究表列的印度南部和西部标本。
scope.en: Museum craniodental comparison across twelve macaque species; the M. radiata sample comprises specimens listed from South and West India.

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This account combines local southern Indian surveys from 2017 with one cross-species museum comparison; it is not a current population census, formal conservation assessment or complete morphology and ecology review.

text.zh: 对 9 只圈养北白颊长臂猿的群内录音，研究者按发声形式归纳出 grunt、hoo 和 long hoo 三类叫声，并在社交、进食、压力和注意等多种情境中记录。样本来自圈养群体，这些类别并不等于完整的野外叫声谱，也不能说明野外个体各年龄阶段的行为。
text.en: Recordings from nine captive northern white-cheeked gibbons were classified into three intragroup call types—grunt, hoo and long hoo—across social, feeding, stress and attention contexts. The sample was captive; these categories are not a complete wild call repertoire and do not establish age-specific behavior in wild animals.

text.zh: 一项粪便 16S 研究分析了中国两家动物园的 56 只圈养北白颊长臂猿，发现肠道微生物群组成和多样性在年龄组之间、以及采用不同圈养条件的成年群体之间存在差异。研究没有测量野外种群，也不能把差异归因于某一项饲养因素。
text.en: A fecal 16S study of 56 captive northern white-cheeked gibbons at two Chinese zoos found differences in gut-microbiome composition and diversity among age groups and between adult groups under different captive conditions. It did not sample wild populations or isolate the effect of any single husbandry factor.

sources.title: Hradec et al. (2026) — Intragroup Vocalizations in Captive Northern White-cheeked Gibbons (Nomascus leucogenys) and Southern Yellow-cheeked Gibbons (Nomascus gabriellae)

scope.zh: 圈养北白颊与南黄颊长臂猿的群内发声研究；本条只采用 9 只北白颊长臂猿的录音结果。
scope.en: Study of intragroup vocalizations in captive northern white-cheeked and southern yellow-cheeked gibbons; this account uses recordings from nine N. leucogenys only.

sources.title: Jia et al. (2018) — The gastrointestinal tract microbiota of northern white-cheeked gibbons (Nomascus leucogenys) varies with age and captive condition

scope.zh: 中国两家动物园 56 只圈养个体的粪便 16S 研究；不代表野外微生物群，也未隔离单一饲养因素。
scope.en: Fecal 16S study of 56 captive animals at two Chinese zoos; it does not represent wild microbiomes or isolate a single husbandry factor.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。两项来源均以圈养个体为对象，分别讨论发声和肠道微生物；不能据此概括野外行为或天然饮食生态。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Both sources concern captive animals and address vocalizations or gut microbiota; they do not establish wild behavior or natural feeding ecology.

text.zh: 菲律宾莱特岛 Hindang 的 Mt. Bontoc 林地碎片中，研究团队在 2021 年 8 月偶遇记录 5 只眼镜猴；2022 年 1–2 月又通过直接目击和相机陷阱记录到 6 次出现。作者无法确认这些记录对应不同个体，也明确表示种群存续能力尚不清楚，因此这些数字不是个体总数或种群估计。
text.en: At the Mt. Bontoc forest fragment in Hindang, Leyte, the team opportunistically recorded five tarsiers in August 2021 and six records from direct sightings and camera traps in January–February 2022. The authors could not establish whether records represented different individuals and said population viability was unknown; these are not a total count or population estimate.

text.zh: 研究者在 Mt. Bontoc 的 5 个眼镜猴目击点周边样方测量了 612 株树木和灌木，平均胸径为 2.5 厘米、平均高度 5.0 米；作者把地点描述为石灰岩上的次生恢复林。这是一个林地碎片的植被样本，不能代表菲律宾眼镜猴所有栖地。
text.en: Around five tarsier sighting sites at Mt. Bontoc, researchers measured 612 woody stems in plots; mean diameter at breast height was 2.5 cm and mean height was 5.0 m. They described the site as regenerating secondary forest on limestone. This vegetation sample from one forest fragment does not represent all habitats used by Philippine tarsiers.

sources.title: Torrefiel et al. (2023) — A detailed assessment of threats to tarsiers and its habitat: The case of a forest fragment-confined population of Philippine Tarsiers Carlito syrichta in Hindang, Leyte

scope.zh: 菲律宾莱特岛 Hindang 的 Mt. Bontoc 林地碎片在 2021–2022 年的局地记录和植被样方；不构成全物种分布或数量调查。
scope.en: Local records and vegetation plots at the Mt. Bontoc forest fragment in Hindang, Leyte, during 2021–2022; not a range-wide distribution or population survey.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。材料只来自莱特岛一个林地碎片的短期研究；个体数无法确认，种群存续能力未知，不能外推至该种全部分布区。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Evidence comes from a short study of one forest fragment on Leyte; individual counts could not be confirmed, viability is unknown, and findings do not generalize across the species' range.

text.zh: 哥斯达黎加 Pacuare 自然保护区 2009–2010 年的一项野外研究，分析了 3 个群体 49 只习惯化白面卷尾猴的 608 次取果焦点跟随。对于研究者按获取难度排序的果实，成年个体的回报率高于较年轻年龄组；对容易获取的果实则未检出显著年龄组差异。这个结果是特定样本和难度分类下的觅食比较，不是全物种食谱。
text.en: A 2009–2010 field study at Pacuare Nature Reserve, Costa Rica, analyzed 608 fruit-foraging focal follows from 49 habituated white-faced capuchins in three groups. Adults had higher return rates than younger age classes for fruits ranked difficult to acquire; no significant age-class difference was detected for easy-to-acquire fruits. This is a foraging comparison within a particular sample and difficulty ranking, not a species-wide diet.

text.zh: 同一研究记录了哥斯达黎加利蒙省 Pacuare 自然保护区南部的 3 个研究群体。它们是研究地点的出现记录，不能用来确定白面卷尾猴完整的地理分布。
text.en: The same study documented three research groups in the southern portion of Pacuare Nature Reserve, Limón Province, Costa Rica. These are records from the study site, not a complete geographic range for the white-faced capuchin.

sources.title: Eadie (2015) — Ontogeny of Foraging Competence in Capuchin Monkeys (Cebus capucinus) for Easy versus Difficult to Acquire Fruits: A Test of the Needing to Learn Hypothesis

scope.zh: 哥斯达黎加 Pacuare 自然保护区 2009–2010 年的白面卷尾猴果实觅食研究；回报率结果限于所用焦点跟随和果实难度类别。
scope.en: Fruit-foraging study of white-faced capuchins at Pacuare Nature Reserve, Costa Rica, in 2009–2010; return-rate results are limited to the focal follows and fruit-difficulty categories used.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. Field evidence is limited to 49 animals and fruit-foraging return rates at one Costa Rican reserve; it does not assess the full diet, range, conservation status or other scientific topics.

text.zh: 在日本南部 Koshima 岛，一个习惯化并接受投食的猕猴群体于 2013 年冬春参加新奇物体和新奇食物测试。研究报告：对新奇物体的谨慎反应重复性较弱且未达显著；对新奇食物的取食与谨慎反应则具有中等且显著的重复性。结果适用于该群体和测试流程，不是全物种的行为平均值。
text.en: At Koshima Island in southern Japan, a habituated and provisioned macaque population took part in novel-object and novel-food tests during winter and spring 2013. The study reported weak, non-significant repeatability for the caution component of novel-object responses, but moderate, significant repeatability for consummatory and caution components of novel-food responses. These results apply to that population and protocol, not a species-wide behavioral average.

sources.title: Arnaud et al. (2017; first published 2016) — Genes, social transmission, but not maternal effects influence responses of wild Japanese macaques (Macaca fuscata) to novel-object and novel-food tests

scope.zh: 日本 Koshima 岛 2013 年冬春开展的新奇物体与食物测试；条目只转述该群体在测试中的反应重复性。
scope.en: Novel-object and food tests at Koshima Island, Japan, during winter and spring 2013; this account uses only response-repeatability results from that population.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The study tested specific responses in one habituated, provisioned population on Koshima Island, Japan; it does not represent other wild populations or provide a complete behavioral or ecological account.

text.zh: 阿尔及利亚 Gouraya 国家公园的两群猕猴在 2007 年 4 月至 2008 年 3 月接受饮食观察。研究报告，靠近城镇的 Les Oliviers 群年度食物植物种多样性为 13.8，高于非城市环境的 Cap Carbon 群的 10.4。比较只涉及这两个群体和一个年度周期，不能说明城市化造成差异或代表整个物种的食性。
text.en: Two macaque groups in Gouraya National Park, Algeria, were observed from April 2007 through March 2008. The study reported higher annual dietary plant-species diversity for the peri-urban Les Oliviers group (13.8) than for the non-urban Cap Carbon group (10.4). The comparison covers these two groups and one annual cycle; it does not show that urbanization caused the difference or represent the species' diet as a whole.

sources.title: Maibeche et al. (2015) — Is Diet Flexibility an Adaptive Life Trait for Relictual and Peri-Urban Populations of the Endangered Primate Macaca sylvanus?

scope.zh: 阿尔及利亚 Gouraya 国家公园两个群体在 2007–2008 年的饮食观察；比较限于报告的地点、样本和观察周期。
scope.en: Diet observations of two groups in Gouraya National Park, Algeria, during 2007–2008; comparison is limited to the reported sites, samples and observation period.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This is a one-year diet comparison of two groups at one site; it does not establish the species' overall diet, a causal effect of urbanization, current trends or conservation status.

text.zh: 云南白马雪山国家级自然保护区一项野生滇金丝猴体重研究报告，8 岁组雄性平均体重为 21.8±2.2 千克（n=35），雌性为 11.8±1.2 千克（n=116），性二型体重比为 1.85。方法把同一个体不同年份的重复记录分别计入样本，因此括号内数量不是独立个体数；结果也只对应该保护区的监测群体和测量设计。
text.en: A body-mass study of wild black-and-white snub-nosed monkeys at Baimaxueshan National Nature Reserve, Yunnan, reported a mean of 21.8±2.2 kg for eight-year-old males (n=35) and 11.8±1.2 kg for females (n=116), a sexual-dimorphism ratio of 1.85. The methods counted repeated annual records of the same monkey separately, so these sample counts are not unique individuals. The result is limited to the monitored population and measurement design.

sources.title: Li et al. (2023) — Ontogenetic Development of Sexual Dimorphism in Body Mass of Wild Black-and-White Snub-Nosed Monkey (Rhinopithecus bieti)

scope.zh: 云南白马雪山保护区 2010–2013 年野生监测群体的体重记录；八岁组比较包含重复年度测量。
scope.en: Body-mass records from a monitored wild population at Baimaxueshan Reserve, Yunnan, during 2010–2013; the age-eight comparison includes repeated annual measurements.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。体重差异来自云南一处保护区的监测样本，且含重复年度记录；不能当作全物种体型值、唯一个体数或完整生长繁殖资料。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. The body-mass contrast comes from one monitored reserve population in Yunnan and includes repeated annual records; it is not a species-wide size estimate, a count of unique individuals or a complete growth and reproduction account.

text.zh: 一项四川省分布研究整合野外调查、保护地记录和历史资料，把 2001–2023 年作为“当前”时段。作者报告，该省当期分布位于邛崃山和岷山海拔约 1,000–4,000 米的区域，并在四川东北部四处低于 1,000 米的地区未发现现存分布。这是四川省范围内的区域评估，不代表川金丝猴在中国全境的完整分布。
text.en: A Sichuan distribution study combined field surveys, protected-area records and historical records, defining 2001–2023 as its current period. The authors reported that the species' distribution in Sichuan was confined to elevations of about 1,000–4,000 m in the Qionglai and Minshan ranges, with no current presence recorded in four northeastern Sichuan areas below 1,000 m. This is a regional assessment for Sichuan, not the complete distribution across China.

sources.title: Dai et al. (2024) — Historical changes in the distribution of the Sichuan golden snub-nosed monkey (Rhinopithecus roxellana) in Sichuan Province, China

scope.zh: 四川省的区域分布综合研究；此处只转述 2001–2023 时段及其山系和海拔结论。
scope.en: Regional distribution synthesis for Sichuan Province; this account uses only the 2001–2023 period and its mountain-range and elevation results.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。正文仅介绍四川省 2001–2023 年区域分布综合，不覆盖中国其他省份，也不构成每个局地种群的现状调查或保育趋势评估。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This account covers a regional distribution synthesis for Sichuan during 2001–2023; it does not cover other Chinese provinces or assess the current status of every local population or conservation trends.

text.zh: 马来西亚沙巴州 Lower Kinabatangan 野生动物保护区的研究，把乘船观察到的取食行为与粪便 trnL DNA 条形码结合，在 155 份粪便样本中记录到至少 89 种被食植物，分属 76 属、45 科。采样跨 2015 年 5–8 月、2016 年 1–6 月和 2016 年 11 月至 2017 年 3 月。这些记录反映所采群体、地点与时段，不是长鼻猴完整食谱。
text.en: In the Lower Kinabatangan Wildlife Sanctuary, Sabah, Malaysia, researchers combined boat-based feeding observations with trnL DNA metabarcoding of 155 fecal samples. They recorded at least 89 consumed plant taxa from 76 genera and 45 families. Sampling covered May–August 2015, January–June 2016 and November 2016–March 2017. These records describe sampled groups, sites and periods, not the complete diet of proboscis monkeys.

sources.title: Thiry et al. (2025) — Using DNA metabarcoding and direct behavioural observations to identify the diet of proboscis monkeys (Nasalis larvatus) in the Kinabatangan Floodplain, Sabah

scope.zh: 沙巴 Lower Kinabatangan 野生动物保护区的自由活动群体；取食观察和粪便采样分别限于论文列出的地点与日期。
scope.en: Free-ranging groups in Sabah's Lower Kinabatangan Wildlife Sanctuary; feeding observations and fecal sampling are limited to the sites and dates reported in the article.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

limitations.zh: 未经过外部领域专家评审。介绍只基于沙巴一处保护区的多时段采样；DNA 条形码与行为观察的结果受方法、群体和地点限制，不构成全域季节性饮食综述。
limitations.en: Source-linked introduction; not externally expert-reviewed. This account uses multi-period sampling from one sanctuary in Sabah; metabarcoding and behavioral observations remain limited by their methods, groups and sites and do not form a range-wide seasonal diet review.

records.scientificName: Pongo tapanuliensis Nurcahyo, Meijaard, Nowak, Fredriksson & Groves in Nater et al., 2017

text.zh: 一项历史资料综合估算，苏门答腊猩猩在 1890 年代的分布范围约 40,796 平方公里，1940 年代约 21,313 平方公里；与之比较的塔巴努里猩猩当前范围约 1,023 平方公里。把历史记录归入塔巴努里猩猩，依赖作者对现分布区以南和东南历史种群的归属假设；北部记录可能属于苏门答腊猩猩，区外旧标本也未做遗传鉴定。因此这些比例是有条件的历史估算，不是已验证的完整分布史。
text.en: A historical synthesis estimated orangutan extents of occurrence at about 40,796 km² in the 1890s and 21,313 km² in the 1940s, compared with an approximately 1,023 km² current range for the Tapanuli orangutan. Attribution of historical records to P. tapanuliensis depends on the authors' interpretation of populations south and southeast of its present range. Northern records may instead be P. abelii, and cited specimens from outside the current range had not been genetically identified. The proportions are therefore conditional historical estimates, not a verified complete range history.

sources.title: Meijaard et al. (2021) — The historical range and drivers of decline of the Tapanuli orangutan

scope.zh: 苏门答腊历史记录的文献和地图综合；面积比例取决于论文对旧记录的分类归属假设，地理精度与分类确认有限。
scope.en: Literature and mapping synthesis of historical Sumatran records; area comparisons depend on taxonomic attribution assumptions and have acknowledged limits in precision and identification.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

text.en: Two social groups in a captive open-diffusion experiment contained 23 Bolivian squirrel monkeys. Of 21 observers, 12 solved the apparatus task at least once, and solvers more often used the response direction demonstrated by a model. This was one artificial task experiment; it does not establish social learning in the wild or a species-wide cognitive capacity.

text.en: At Ketambe in Sumatra, Hardus and colleagues recorded three slow-loris eating events involving one adult female Sumatran orangutan and her dependent daughter. The events occurred in 2007–2008. The mother often rejected the offspring's requests for meat, while the offspring initiated sharing. These observations describe one mother–daughter pair, not a species-wide feeding or family pattern.

text.en: Researchers played alarm calls from familiar and unfamiliar monkeys to wild Diana monkeys at Taï Forest in Côte d’Ivoire and Tiwai Island in Sierra Leone. The calls referred to leopard and eagle threats. Responses varied with social familiarity and habitat context. These playback results describe reactions to particular calls in the studied groups, not actual predation risk or a complete social network.

text.zh: 在乌干达西部 Kalinzu 森林，一项研究对一个习惯化家族群进行了 4,308 小时观察。研究者记录到，取食时间中 87.0% 用于嫩叶、9.8% 用于果实，其余为花、树皮、土壤等。针对已取食叶片的细分分析发现，蛋白质、可消化性和韧度与选择有关；这些指标不能解释更宽泛的“吃或不吃”差别，结果也只代表该群体和时段。
text.en: At Kalinzu Forest in western Uganda, researchers observed one habituated family group for 4,308 hours. Young leaves accounted for 87.0% of feeding time and fruit for 9.8%, with the remainder including flowers, bark and soil. In fine-grained analyses of leaves that were eaten, protein, digestibility and toughness were associated with choices; those measures did not explain the broader eaten-versus-not-eaten pattern. The results concern this group and period.

text.en: A zoo report described a captive-born female drill that continued post-mortem care of her infant for about two days and then consumed the body; no sharing by other group members was observed.
