text.zh: 研究团队在马达加斯加西北部 Nosy Be 的 15 条样线上，于 2023 年雨季进行夜间距离抽样，46.5 千米路线记录到 92 次目击，平均密度估计为每平方千米 125.1 只（95% CI：65.3–239.5）。把该研究区密度外推至岛上分布范围内的森林，得到约 4,700 只的模型估计；这不是实地普查，也不代表全物种分布范围。
text.en: During wet-season nocturnal distance sampling on Nosy Be in northwestern Madagascar, researchers recorded 92 visual detections along 46.5 km of 15 transects in 2023. Mean density was estimated at 125.1 animals per km² (95% CI 65.3–239.5). Extrapolation to forest within the mapped island range produced an estimate of about 4,700 animals; it is a model-based island estimate, not a census or an estimate for the full species range.

text.zh: 一项实验纳入六只圈养出生的雄性灰鼠狐猴，其中两只接受 10°C 低温处理 17 天。在这两只个体的冬眠样蛰伏期间，睡眠—觉醒节律仍持续，记录到的睡眠多为非快速眼动睡眠；体温降至 21°C 以下时，脑电转为等电状态。低温组只有两只，不能据此设定全物种阈值，也不能推断野外种群的睡眠模式。
text.en: A laboratory study included six captive-born male gray mouse lemurs; two underwent 17 days at 10°C. During torpor in those two animals, sleep–wake rhythms continued and recorded sleep was mostly non-REM. EEG became isoelectric when body temperature fell below 21°C. The low-temperature group contained only two animals, so the result does not set a species-wide threshold or describe sleep in wild populations.

scope.en: A laboratory colony in Brunoy, France; four of six males remained at 24–26°C and two received 17 days at 10°C, so low-temperature comparisons are limited to n=2.

The result is limited to one forest and sampling design; it does not establish a causal edge effect or species-wide pattern.

text.en: At Furuviksparken in Sweden, five captive-born adult white-faced sakis were offered all pairwise combinations of 15 foods from their usual managed diet, with each pair presented ten times. The 5,250 choices were repeated presentations to the same five animals and do not represent wild feeding preferences.

text.zh: Jersey Zoo 的圈养群体研究比较了反复腹泻、体重下降个体与未受影响个体的粪便微生物。16S 分析实际纳入 6 只受影响个体和 13 只对照；受影响组中部分乳杆菌序列变体比例较高，对照组中若干 Lachnospiraceae 与 Ruminococcaceae 变体较高。受影响样本更少，且个体年龄和既往抗生素暴露不同；研究不能说明因果，也不代表野外肠道微生物。
text.en: A study of the captive Jersey Zoo colony compared fecal microbiomes of pied tamarins with recurrent diarrhea and weight loss against unaffected animals. The 16S analysis included six affected and 13 unaffected animals; some Lactobacillus sequence variants were relatively more abundant in the affected group, while some Lachnospiraceae and Ruminococcaceae variants were higher in controls. The affected sample was smaller, and age and lifetime antibiotic exposure differed, so the study does not show causation or describe wild microbiomes.

text.en: Acoustic surveys at six sites in Kachin State and three in Shan State, Myanmar, recorded 23 and 21 gibbon groups, respectively. Genetic identification from skin and saliva matched Hoolock tianxing reference sequences at 99.54–100% identity. The results confirm occurrence at surveyed sites, not a range-wide population estimate; Kayah and Kayin sites were inaccessible.

text.zh: 沙特阿拉伯西南部一项 GPS 研究比较自然、半自然和城市环境中雄性哈马狒狒代表的最短日移动距离。10 只成年雄性佩戴项圈，其中 9 只成功追踪，累计 13,962 个定位点，平均运行 256 天；三类环境间的移动距离存在统计差异。结果描述被追踪雄性，不能证明栖地造成差异，也不代表全种移动模式。
text.en: A GPS study in southwestern Saudi Arabia compared minimum daily path lengths of male hamadryas baboon troop representatives in natural, semi-natural and urban settings. Ten adult males were collared; nine were successfully tracked, yielding 13,962 locations over an average of 256 days. Path lengths differed statistically among the three categories. The result describes the tracked males and does not prove a causal habitat effect or species-wide movement pattern.

scope.en: Ten locations in five regions of southwestern Saudi Arabia; males were collared in August 2022, and nine functioning collars recorded through May 2023 for an average of about 256 days.

text.en: A short post-release study at Mehao Wildlife Sanctuary in Arunachal Pradesh, India, recorded feeding by three Eastern hoolock gibbon family groups. Fruits and flowers were observed in the two Sally Lake groups; leaves and animal matter were also recorded for the 20 Kilo group. Each group was monitored for about two months. These observations concern rescued and released groups, not the species’ usual or range-wide diet.

text.en: A study across 22 sites in Argentina, Paraguay and Brazil analysed genetic samples from 256 black-and-gold howlers. Four sites were sampled before reservoir flooding; samples from those sites showed higher mitochondrial and microsatellite diversity. The findings apply to the sampled populations and markers.

text.zh: 研究在 4 个后来被淹没地点记录到 14 种线粒体单倍型，其中 13 种没有出现在其余受调查地点。作者认为部分地方遗传变异可能随淹没消失，同时指出采样没有覆盖全物种分布，因此不能断言这些变异在其他种群中也不存在。
text.en: The study recorded 14 mitochondrial haplotypes at four sites that were later flooded; 13 were not found at the other sampled sites. The authors suggest that some local genetic variation may have been lost with inundation, while noting that sampling did not cover the species’ full range and cannot show that these variants are absent from other populations.

text.zh: 在美国密西西比州 Pearl River 与 Ross Barnett Reservoir 的研究中，研究者于 2012–2013 年追踪了 17 只成年雄性短吻鳄，获得 1,145 个定位点。家域尺度与家域内斑块尺度的栖地选择并不相同；一些个体在较细尺度上选择了浮水或挺水植被斑块。
text.en: At the Pearl River and Ross Barnett Reservoir in Mississippi, researchers tracked 17 adult male alligators in 2012–2013 and collected 1,145 locations. Habitat selection differed between home-range and within-range patch scales; some individuals selected patches with floating or emergent vegetation.

text.zh: 这 17 只雄性样本中，体长与家域面积或栖地资源选择没有检出关联。结果来自一个河流—水库系统的成年雄性，不能代表雌性、幼体或其他地区的短吻鳄。
text.en: In this sample of 17 males, body size was not associated with home-range size or resource selection. The result comes from adult males in one river–reservoir system and does not establish patterns for females, juveniles or other regions.

text.en: From 1997 to 2000, researchers compared 2-hectare nest-box plots where great tits bred with matched control plots in 12 commercial Dutch apple orchards: six under integrated pest management and six organic. In the integrated-management orchards, caterpillar damage affected 2.9% of apples in plots with breeding tits versus 5.8% in controls; the study did not show the same reduction in organic orchards.

text.zh: 一项覆盖 23 种现生鳄类的成体咬力研究，把扬子鳄与宽吻凯门鳄列为吻部较宽钝、牙齿圆钝的硬壳猎物类型。研究者测得这两种体型相近，但它们的臼齿形牙齿压力值仍分布在同体型鳄类的较大范围内；单看吻形并不能可靠预测咬力。取食类型的概述结合了既有文献，实验本身测量的是圈养和馆藏成体的咬合表现。
text.en: An adult bite-force study covering 23 living crocodilian species grouped the Chinese alligator with the broad-snouted caiman as a blunt-snouted, blunt-toothed type associated with hard-shelled prey. The similarly sized species still spanned much of the molariform tooth-pressure range among crocodilians of comparable size, and snout shape alone did not reliably predict bite force. The feeding description synthesizes earlier literature; the experiment measured biting performance in adult research, conservation and display specimens.

text.zh: 咬力实验将宽吻凯门鳄与长吻的澳洲淡水鳄作了对照：两种吻形差异显著、体型相近的鳄类，后部臼齿形牙位的咬力却处于相近水平。跨 23 种的分析显示，体质量比吻宽更能解释咬力；短宽吻型的牙齿压力数据也没有形成一个彼此一致的简单分组。
text.en: The bite-force experiment compared the broad-snouted caiman with the long-snouted Australian freshwater crocodile: despite sharply different snout shapes, similarly sized animals produced comparable bite forces at the rear molariform tooth position. Across 23 living species, body mass explained bite force better than snout width, and tooth-pressure values did not form a simple, uniform group for broad-snouted forms.

limitations.en: A focused comparative biomechanics guide; not externally expert-reviewed. The experiment used adult specimens from research, conservation and display collections; it was not a field feeding study and does not cover the species' full life history or population variation.

text.zh: 在一项对 23 种现生鳄类的成体咬力实验中，澳洲淡水鳄的体型校正后前部犬齿形牙压力偏高，臼齿形牙压力也相对较高。作者指出，它的窄长吻和这些牙齿压力特征，与针对小型猎物的取食类型相符；不过实验直接测量的是咬合力和牙齿压力，食性解释还依赖先前研究。
text.en: In an adult bite-force experiment spanning 23 living crocodilian species, the Australian freshwater crocodile showed relatively high body-size-standardized pressure at its front caniniform teeth and comparatively high pressure at molariform teeth. The authors related its slender snout and pressure profile to feeding on small prey, while the experiment itself directly measured biting force and tooth pressure; the dietary interpretation also draws on earlier studies.

text.zh: 跨 23 种现生鳄类的咬力研究发现，恒河鳄是体型校正后咬力偏低的统计离群种；与此同时，它前部犬齿形牙的压力却很高。作者将这种组合与极窄长的吻部和细长、接触面积很小的牙齿联系起来：力值较低，不代表局部牙齿压力也低。
text.en: A bite-force study spanning 23 living crocodilian species found the gharial to be a statistical low-force outlier after accounting for body size, yet it generated high pressure at its front caniniform teeth. The authors linked this combination to its extremely slender snout and narrow teeth with very small contact areas: lower force does not mean lower local tooth pressure.

text.zh: 一项成体鳄类比较研究报告，湾鳄一个个体的实测咬力为 16,414 N，是该研究中测得的最高值；按分类单元汇总的后部臼齿形牙代表值则为 8,983 N。单个最大值和物种代表值是不同统计量，研究同时发现体质量是鳄类咬力差异的主要解释因素。
text.en: A comparative study of adult crocodilians reported a measured bite force of 16,414 N for one saltwater crocodile, the highest individual value in that study; its taxon-representative value at the rear molariform tooth position was 8,983 N. These are different statistics, and the study also found body mass to be the main explanation for bite-force variation among crocodilians.

text.zh: 北澳大利亚的卫星追踪研究把 5 只成年雄性湾鳄迁放到离捕获点 100–320 公里的地点；它们海上移动时总体朝原捕获点方向，但都没有绕过 Cobourg Peninsula 完成返回。对照个体中有一只在首年后进行了约 900 公里的六个月往返旅程。该结果说明迁放效果受地理阻隔和个体差异影响，不是所有湾鳄的固定移动规律。
text.en: A satellite-tracking study in northern Australia moved five adult male saltwater crocodiles 100–320 km from their capture sites. Their sea movements were generally directed toward the original sites, but none completed the return around Cobourg Peninsula. One control animal later made a roughly 900 km journey over six months before returning. The result shows that translocation outcomes depend on geographic barriers and individual variation; it is not a fixed movement rule for all saltwater crocodiles.

text.zh: 一项跨美洲和大安的列斯群岛的研究结合线粒体控制区与 11 个核微卫星位点，发现所采样地点之间存在明显遗传结构；大陆样本与大安的列斯群岛样本分化尤其大，古巴与牙买加样本之间也有区分。委内瑞拉样本还报告了 3 个此前未见的单倍型。作者据此强调，美洲鳄的遗传关系需按区域和样点理解。
text.en: A study spanning the Americas and Greater Antilles combined mitochondrial control-region data with 11 nuclear microsatellite loci and found strong genetic structure among sampled localities. Differentiation was especially pronounced between continental and Greater Antillean samples, with additional separation between Cuba and Jamaica; the Venezuelan samples yielded three newly reported haplotypes. The results show why American-crocodile genetic relationships should be interpreted by region and sampling locality.

text.zh: 一项哥伦比亚—委内瑞拉区域综述整理了 1900–2015 年间涉及奥里诺科鳄生物学或生态的 289 份文献，并汇集 1,334 个目击或活动巢记录；其中 125 个经空间稀疏化后用于栖地模型训练。模型在明确阈值下估计潜在适宜区域，并划分保护/监测重点和研究优先区。作者指出高适宜度区域中只有一部分位于保护区，模型结果表达的是资料支持下的潜在分布，不是当时或当前的实测种群范围。
text.en: A Colombia–Venezuela regional synthesis reviewed 289 documents on Orinoco-crocodile biology or ecology published from 1900 to 2015 and assembled 1,334 sighting or active-nest records; 125 spatially rarefied locations were used to train its habitat model. Under stated thresholds, the model estimated potential suitable areas and identified conservation and research priorities. Only part of the high-suitability area fell within protected areas. The model represents potential distribution supported by the available records, not a measured population range at that time or today.

text.zh: 乌干达纳布加博湖附近一支罗文佐里安哥拉疣猴（Colobus angolensis ruwenzorii）群体的一年观察，在 135 只个体中识别出 12 个核心单元；部分核心单元以非随机方式聚集为两个 clan，研究据此区分核心单元、clan 和 band 三个社会层级。这描述的是一个地点、一个亚种的研究群体，不能直接推广到 Colobus angolensis 的所有种群。
text.en: A year-long study of one Rwenzori Angolan colobus (Colobus angolensis ruwenzorii) band near Lake Nabugabo, Uganda, identified 12 core units among 135 individuals. Some core units associated non-randomly in two clans, supporting three observed levels: core unit, clan and band. This describes one studied population of one subspecies and should not be generalized to every Colobus angolensis population.

scope.en: One Rwenzori Angolan colobus band near Lake Nabugabo, Uganda; observations from August 2017 to July 2018, with the studied taxon identified as the subspecies Colobus angolensis ruwenzorii.

text.zh: 一项巴西南巴伊亚研究以 Colônia 的一支金头狮面狨群体为焦点，并参考 Una 生物保护区两群在另一项目中收集的轨迹，建立 Pourouma 种子传播模型。Colônia 群体在该树属结果季的 26 个完整观察日中，平均每日轨迹约 1.87 km；观察到的 Pourouma 种子平均距母树约 111 m。作者的模型提示，较短的日常行程对远距离森林更新贡献可能有限，却可能支持资源树种在当地的种子沉积。沉积模拟对果实成熟阈值和觅食树距离敏感，结果限于单一场地、焦点群体、树属和模型设定。
text.en: A study in southern Bahia, Brazil, focused on one golden-headed lion tamarin group at Colônia and also used movement records from two groups previously studied at Una Biological Reserve to model Pourouma seed dispersal. Across 26 complete observation days during fruiting season, the Colônia group averaged about 1.87 km per day; observed Pourouma seeds averaged about 111 m from their parent trees. The model suggests these short daily paths may contribute little to long-distance forest regeneration while supporting local seed deposition. Deposition outputs were sensitive to fruit-maturity and feeding-distance thresholds, so results are limited to one site, focal group, tree genus and model setup.

limitations.en: Source-linked introduction, not externally expert-reviewed. Seed-dispersal evidence comes from one focal group and a site-specific model of one tree genus; model sensitivity does not support a range-wide ecological estimate.

text.zh: 一项研究在巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州阿尔费纳斯周边的 45 个大西洋森林残片中，以叫声回放调查灵长类；2010 年 7 月至 2013 年 1 月期间，黑额蒂蒂猴在其中 28 片被记录到。研究比较了林片面积、功能隔离、林片间可视性和周围土地类型构成等变量，面积是解释出现记录的主要因素。作者又在邻近波索丰多的 20 个林片测试候选模型，但论文摘要与图 6 图注对黑额蒂蒂猴通过验证的模型所含次级变量说法不一致；这里不替来源消解该差异。结果仅描述两个相邻地区的局地出现模式，不是全分布区数量或栖地偏好的估计。
text.en: A study used playback surveys in 45 Atlantic Forest remnants around Alfenas, Minas Gerais, Brazil. From July 2010 to January 2013, black-fronted titi monkeys were recorded in 28 fragments. The researchers compared patch area, functional isolation, visibility between remnants and surrounding land-use composition; patch area was the leading explanation for local occurrence records. They tested candidate models again in 20 fragments near Poço Fundo, but the abstract and Figure 6 caption disagree about the secondary variable in the named validated model for this species. This guide leaves that discrepancy unresolved. The results describe local occurrence in two neighboring landscapes, not abundance or habitat preference across the full range.

text.zh: 在巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州阿尔费纳斯周边 45 个大西洋森林残片的叫声回放调查中，研究者于 2010–2013 年在 15 片记录到黄耳狨。比较模型把林片面积、功能隔离、林片间可视性和周围土地类型纳入考虑；面积是解释物种出现的主要变量，最佳模型的统计检验为 p=0.023。作者随后用邻近波索丰多的 20 个林片检验候选模型，列出的三个通过验证模型对应另外两种灵长类，没有黄耳狨模型。这表示该研究没有在第二地点验证出黄耳狨模型，不表示当地没有黄耳狨，也不能单凭这项局地研究归纳全种生态。
text.en: Playback surveys recorded buffy-tufted-ear marmosets in 15 of 45 Atlantic Forest remnants around Alfenas, Minas Gerais, Brazil, during 2010–2013. Candidate models considered patch area, functional isolation, visibility between remnants and surrounding land-use composition. Patch area was the leading variable explaining occurrence, and the best model had a reported p-value of 0.023. The authors then tested candidate models in 20 fragments near Poço Fundo; the three models reported as validated concerned the other two primate species, not this marmoset. That means this study did not validate a marmoset model at the second site. It does not mean the species was absent there or establish ecology across its range.

text.zh: 一项巴西大西洋森林破碎化研究在阿尔费纳斯周边 45 个林片中，用叫声回放于 2010–2013 年记录到 9 片有黑卷尾猴。模型比较显示林片面积是解释出现记录的主要因素，功能隔离、可视性与周围土地类型则作为次级变量与面积一起进入部分候选模型。研究者在邻近波索丰多的 20 个林片进行验证；但论文摘要把通过验证的黑卷尾猴模型写成“面积”与“面积加可视性”，图 6 图注则写成“面积”与“面积加土地类型”。本导读保留面积的重要性，不替原文决定第二项组合。样点与模型只反映该地区，不是全分布区的数量或普遍栖地要求。
text.en: A study of fragmentation in Brazil's Atlantic Forest used playback surveys around Alfenas and recorded black capuchins in 9 of 45 fragments during 2010–2013. Model comparisons identified patch area as the leading explanation for local occurrence; functional isolation, visibility and surrounding land use appeared as secondary variables in some candidates that also included area. The authors tested models in 20 fragments near Poço Fundo, but the abstract lists area and area-plus-visibility models for this species, while the Figure 6 caption lists area and area-plus-matrix models. This guide retains the finding that area mattered without choosing between those conflicting descriptions. The sites and models do not establish abundance or general habitat requirements across the species' range.

text.zh: 2012 年一项比较研究测量了当时认可的 23 种现生鳄类、共 83 只性成熟个体。研究在上颌后部的主要磨牙位点报告的类群代表咬合力，从库氏凯门鳄的 900 N 到湾鳄的 8,983 N。跨种比较中，体质量是咬合力的主要解释变量；系统发育校正后的模型 R² 为 0.87。吻部相对比例只解释体质量标准化后剩余变异的一小部分，因此宽吻本身不能直接当作更大咬力的替代量；恒河鳄是相对咬力偏低的例外。样本与分类口径属于 2012 年研究，COL26.8 现生鳄目接受种分母为 27；未把后来区分的谱系或旧名下未分开的样本强行映射到新种。
text.en: A 2012 comparison measured 83 sexually mature individuals from the 23 living crocodilian species recognized at the time. At the prominent molariform tooth near the back of the upper jaw, taxon-representative bite forces ranged from 900 N in Cuvier's dwarf caiman to 8,983 N in the saltwater crocodile. Body mass was the main cross-species predictor; the phylogenetically corrected model had R² = 0.87. Rostral proportion explained only a small part of the remaining size-standardized variation, so a broad snout is not a direct proxy for greater bite force; the gharial was the low-relative-force exception. The study's samples and taxonomy are historical: COL26.8 counts 27 accepted living crocodilian species, and this guide does not reassign records from older, broader taxon concepts to later-separated species.

limitations.zh: 来源链接的类群导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。数据反映有限的成年机构样本及 2012 年所用分类；COL26.8 的现生鳄目分母为 27 种，后续分类拆分未据旧样本推算。

text.zh: Erickson 等在 2012 年比较研究中测量了 菲律宾鳄 的 1 只性成熟个体，样本平均体质量约 69 kg。研究在上颌后部主要磨牙位点报告的类群代表咬合力为 2,736 N；研究仅测得一只性成熟个体，无法估计种内范围。每只动物进行了 3–5 次咬合，分析采用最高读数。该研究跨种比较显示体质量是咬合力的主要解释变量，吻部比例只解释少量额外差异。结果是有限机构样本中的标准化实验测量，不是该种野外捕食力常数或种群范围。
text.en: In Erickson et al.'s 2012 comparison, 1 sexually mature philippine crocodile were tested, with a mean sample body mass of about 69 kg. At the prominent molariform tooth near the back of the upper jaw, the study reported a taxon-representative bite force of 2,736 N; only one sexually mature individual was tested, so no within-species range can be estimated. Researchers used the highest of 3–5 bites per animal. Across species, body mass was the main predictor of bite force, while rostral proportion explained little additional variation. This is a standardized measurement from a limited institutional sample, not a field-performance constant or population range.

text.zh: 对非洲鳄类现生材料与埃及木乃伊的线粒体、核标记和核型比较，为尼罗鳄类群中与西非鳄（Crocodylus suchus）相符的一条隐存谱系提供证据。木乃伊单倍型还提示，历史上的尼罗河曾出现两条鳄属谱系。这是系统发育与历史标本证据，不能据此划定今天的分布边界或估计数量。
text.en: Comparisons of mitochondrial and nuclear markers and karyotypes from African crocodile samples and Egyptian mummies supported a cryptic lineage corresponding to the West African crocodile, Crocodylus suchus, within the Nile crocodile complex. Mummy haplotypes also indicate that two Crocodylus lineages occurred historically along the Nile. These are phylogenetic and historical-specimen findings, not a current range boundary or abundance estimate.

scope.en: Phylogenetic study combining modern African crocodile samples, karyotypes and Egyptian mummy DNA; supports the cryptic-lineage and historical Nile findings, not current abundance or a complete range estimate.

text.zh: 对新几内亚鳄头骨的几何形态测量比较，识别出中央高地以南的一组形态差异，并据此描述霍尔新几内亚鳄（Crocodylus halli）为独立种。原研究讨论的头骨与体表鳞片特征可用于和北部的新几内亚鳄比较；这不是覆盖全岛所有种群的野外鉴定键，也不代表完整生态调查。
text.en: Geometric morphometric comparisons of New Guinea crocodile skulls identified a morphologically distinct group south of the Central Highlands, which the authors described as Hall's New Guinea crocodile, Crocodylus halli. The paper discusses cranial and scale characters for comparison with the northern New Guinea crocodile. This is not a field key covering every population on the island or a complete ecological survey.

Nasal shape and the snout length-to-width ratio at the premaxillary notch were especially informative. The paper concerns cranial diagnosis; one ratio is not an absolute field character independent of age, individual variation or measurement method.

text.zh: 刚果西北部一处森林沼泽调查点记录到刚果矮鳄（Osteolaemus osborni）与侏儒鳄（O. tetraspis）同域出现。研究以超过 400 个核基因座、约 65 万个碱基的基因组数据比较少数个体，发现两者的遗传分化与南美矮凯门鳄类群之间的分化相近。共享地点的样本很少；作者指出还需更大样本才能检验杂交等问题，因此这一结果不能说明全域共存频率或基因流。
text.en: A survey site in a forest swamp in northwestern Congo recorded the Congo dwarf crocodile (Osteolaemus osborni) and the dwarf crocodile (O. tetraspis) in syntopy. The study compared a small number of individuals using more than 400 nuclear loci, about 650,000 base pairs, and found divergence comparable to that between South American dwarf-caiman lineages. The shared-site sample was small; the authors called for larger samples to examine questions such as hybridization. This does not establish range-wide co-occurrence or gene flow.

text.zh:
一项在泰国Sakaerat 生物圈保护区开展的研究跟踪了一个约 143 只的野生觅食群体。四个月先导期之后，研究者在 2016 和 2017 年两期共 13 个月内采集习惯化数据，并按相遇频率、接触时长、猴群对观察者的反应和数据采集进展划分早期、最低限度、部分、进阶和完全五阶段。论文的时间口径并不一致：结果部分称习惯化近 10 个月后达到完全阶段，摘要和结论则称接近 13 个月。

研究者只从部分阶段开始用扫描取样记录活动。部分和进阶阶段的观察偏向成年雄性和亚成体；猴群年龄—性别组成直到完全阶段才与群体普查构成不再显著不同。活动记录也随习惯化推进而变化：移动记录下降，社交行为记录上升。该单群体对照显示，观察者及习惯化进度会影响哪些个体和行为进入资料。

结果来自一名观察者、一个群体和一处退化森林片区；接近 10 到 13 个月不能视为全物种固定的习惯化周期，群体组成与活动模式也不能外推至其他地点。作者还讨论了适应人类后警戒降低可能带来的保护风险，因此习惯化既是研究方法，也是需要权衡的保护问题.
text.en:
A study at Sakaerat Biosphere Reserve in Thailand followed one wild-feeding troop of about 143 northern pig-tailed macaques. After a four-month pilot, habituation data were collected during two field periods in 2016 and 2017, spanning 13 months. The researchers defined five stages—early, minimal, partial, advanced, and full—using encounter frequency, contact duration, responses to the observer, and progress in data collection. The paper gives two different timings: its Results section says the troop reached the full stage after almost 10 months, while the abstract and conclusion describe the process as close to 13 months.

Scan samples began only at the partial stage. Observations during the partial and advanced stages overrepresented adult males and subadults; observed age-sex composition did not match the troop demographic count until the full stage. Recorded movement also declined and social behavior increased as habituation progressed. This single-troop comparison shows how observer presence and habituation stage affected which individuals and behaviors entered the dataset.

The work concerns one observer, one troop, and one degraded forest fragment. The roughly 10-to-13-month timing is not a species-wide constant, and the observed group composition and activity patterns are not range-wide descriptions. The authors also discuss conservation risks when habituated primates lose fear of people, so habituation is both a research method and a conservation tradeoff.

sources.title: Gazagne et al. (2020) — Toward a better understanding of habituation process to human observer: A statistical approach in Macaca leonina (Primates: Cercopithecidea)

scope.zh: 泰国Sakaerat 生物圈保护区单一野生觅食群体的观察者习惯化研究；样本、阶段与时间结果均限于该地点和研究设计。
scope.en: Habituation to an observer in one wild-feeding troop at Sakaerat Biosphere Reserve, Thailand; the sample, stages, and timeline remain specific to that site and study design.

It concerns one observer, one troop, and one fragmented forest site in Thailand; it does not establish range-wide group composition, activity budgets, or a fixed habituation duration for northern pig-tailed macaques. The paper provides neither a current population census nor a formal conservation assessment.

text.zh: Ram 等在西高止山脉取样的狮尾猴中识别出帕尔加特山口以北和以南的线粒体分支；基于 893 个线粒体碱基的化石校准分析，将两支最近共同祖先的平均时间估为 211 万年前。这是受地点和线粒体标记限制的模型结果，不是全基因组种群史或物种分化日期。研究还发现，阿纳马莱地区八个森林碎片样点的 HVR-I 多样性低于邻近连续森林样点；这不是当前种群存续能力或正式保育等级评估。
text.en: Ram et al. recovered mitochondrial clades north and south of the Palghat Gap among sampled lion-tailed macaques in the Western Ghats. A fossil-calibrated analysis of 893 mitochondrial bases estimated a mean 2.11 million years to the clades' most recent common ancestor. This is a marker- and locality-bounded model result, not a genome-wide population history or species divergence date. The study also found lower HVR-I diversity at eight sampled Anamalai forest fragments than at a nearby continuous-forest population; this is not a current viability or formal conservation assessment.

text.zh: 在泰米尔纳德邦瓦尔帕赖高原一处森林斑块，研究者于 2016 年旱季跟踪一群狮尾猴 480 多小时，比较林内、林缘、开阔林地斑块和人类居住地。该群在开阔斑块和林缘的主动觅食高于林内，在居住地则低于林内；研究期间还记录到 19 种植物性食物及非植物食物。另一项研究在同一高原另一处 92 公顷斑块观察四群共 375.9 小时；其未评审预印本报告，受观察亚成体摄食的本地及非本地水果种类多于成年个体，传播的榕属种子少于成年雌性。两项结果均限于少数猴群、单一地点和旱季；后者是未经同行评审的预印本。
text.en: At a forest fragment on the Valparai plateau in Tamil Nadu, researchers followed one lion-tailed macaque troop for more than 480 hours during the 2016 dry season, comparing forest interior, edge, an open patch, and a human settlement. Active foraging was higher in the open patch and edge than in the interior, and lower in the settlement; the study also recorded plant foods from 19 species and non-plant foods. A separate study watched four troops for 375.9 hours at another 92-hectare fragment on the same plateau. Its unreviewed preprint reports that sampled subadults ate a greater diversity of native and non-native fruits than adults and dispersed fewer Ficus seeds than adult females. Both findings are limited to a few groups, one site, and one dry season; the latter is a preprint not certified by peer review.

sources.title: Ram et al. (2015) — Pre-Historic and Recent Vicariance Events Shape Genetic Structure and Diversity in Endangered Lion-Tailed Macaque in the Western Ghats: Implications for Conservation

scope.zh: 西高止山脉野生样本的线粒体 DNA 研究，部分分析另列圈养血样；支持所采样地点、标记与碎片化种群的比较。
scope.en: Mitochondrial-DNA study of wild Western Ghats samples, with separately identified captive blood samples in some analyses; supports comparisons among sampled localities, markers, and fragmented populations.

scope.en: bioRxiv v1 preprint not certified by peer review; 375.9 observation hours across four troops at one 92-hectare fragment in one dry season.

limitations.zh: 这是基于既有审计来源的双语导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。行为资料来自两个地点的少数猴群；四群体研究是未经同行评审的预印本。采样和线粒体结果不能代替全域普查、当前种群趋势、全基因组历史或完整生态评估。
limitations.en: This bilingual guide draws on already audited sources and is not externally expert-reviewed. Behavioural data come from a few troops at two sites; the four-troop study is a preprint not certified by peer review. These samples and mitochondrial findings do not replace a range-wide census, current population trends, genome-wide history, or a complete ecological assessment.

text.zh: Jordan 等比较了六个现生狒狒属物种的 Alu 插入多态位点，每种取样两只个体。按作者在这 12 只个体面板中的标准，4,645 个位点同时出现在两只橄榄狒狒样本中、而未见于其余狒狒样本，因此被归为 P. anubis 指示位点。这个计数依赖小型比较面板，不能代表橄榄狒狒的全部遗传变异，也不能单独解析狒狒属所有网状演化关系。
text.en: Jordan et al. compared Alu insertion polymorphisms across six living Papio species, sampling two individuals per species. Under the authors' criterion for this 12-individual panel, 4,645 insertions occurred in both sampled olive baboons and were absent from the other sampled baboons, so they were classed as indicative of P. anubis. This count depends on a small comparative panel; it does not represent all genetic variation in olive baboons or resolve every reticulate relationship in Papio.

sources.title: Jordan et al. (2018) — A computational reconstruction of Papio phylogeny using Alu insertion polymorphisms

scope.zh: 六个现生 Papio 物种、每种两只个体的 Alu 插入比较基因组面板；支持面板内的物种指示位点分类，不支持全种变异估计。
scope.en: Comparative Alu-insertion genomic panel of two individuals from each of six extant Papio species; supports the panel-relative classification of species-indicative insertions, not a species-wide variation estimate.

limitations.en: Source-linked comparative-genomics guide, not externally expert-reviewed. The study sampled only two individuals per baboon species; 4,645 is a panel-relative count of indicative insertions, not a range-wide estimate of within-species polymorphism or species boundaries.

text.zh: 一项苏黎世灵长类研究站的圈养实验，让 6 只成年普通狨（3 雄、3 雌）参加研究者安排的 8 组混合性别配对。配对前，原本陌生的个体经过反复短时视觉接触后，模型估计其直接距离平均每次接触缩短 32.3%；配对后，配偶身份与直接距离没有明确关联（P=0.37）。研究还分析 91 段录像中的 436 次性社交行为，发现配对前扫描记录较多，而配对后配偶组的行为计数低于较不熟悉的非配偶组。样本少、伴侣由研究者分配；结果描述的是圈养短时实验，不是野外社会结构或自由择偶。
text.en: In a captive study at the UZH Primate Station in Switzerland, six adult common marmosets (three males and three females) took part in eight researcher-assigned mixed-sex dyads. Before pairing, repeated short visual exposures between unfamiliar animals were associated with a model-estimated 32.3% decrease in direct distance per exposure; after pairing, mate status had no clear association with distance (P=0.37). The study also analyzed 436 sociosexual behaviors in 91 recordings: scan counts were higher before pairing, while after pairing counts were lower in pair-mate than in less familiar extra-pair dyads. The small sample and assigned partners make this a captive short-term assay, not evidence about wild social structure or free mate choice.

sources.title: Wienand, Burkart & Wierucka (2026) — Spatial and Sociosexual Behavior During Pair Formation in Common Marmosets (Callithrix jacchus)

scope.zh: 苏黎世一处灵长类研究站中 6 只圈养成年狨猴的 8 组研究者安排配对；支持短时视觉接触、个体间距离和性社交行为分析。
scope.en: Eight researcher-assigned pairs involving six captive adult marmosets at one Swiss primate station; supports analyses of short visual exposures, interindividual distance, and sociosexual behavior.

limitations.en: Source-linked captive pair-formation study guide, not externally expert-reviewed. It covers six adults, eight researcher-assigned dyads, and one station; it cannot establish wild mate choice, long-term pair maintenance, or species-wide social behavior.

text.zh: 在波多黎各圣地亚哥岛，研究者于 2015 年捕捉—释放期间测量了 125 只至少六岁的自由活动成年雄性恒河猴和 21 只亲缘雌性。在合并雌雄数据的谱系模型中，体重、头臀长、犬齿长度和上腹部皮褶厚度达到作者采用的遗传率阈值（h²≥0.1）；睾丸体积估计低于阈值。作者强调遗传率区间较宽。这些是一个管理型岛屿种群中的选定性状，不代表整个物种分布区内的形态变异。
text.en: During a 2015 capture-release period on Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico, researchers measured 125 free-ranging adult male rhesus macaques aged at least six years and 21 related females. In pedigree models combining male and female data, body mass, crown-rump length, canine length, and upper abdominal skinfold thickness met the authors' heritability threshold (h²≥0.1); the testis-volume estimate was below it. The authors emphasize that heritability intervals were wide. These are selected traits in one managed island population, not a description of morphological variation across the species range.

text.zh: 同一研究用年均后代产量作为繁殖成功的替代指标，检验雄性测量性状是否与该指标相关；研究没有发现明确的定向、稳定化、分裂或相关选择证据。年均后代数不是终生繁殖成功，未检出明确选择也不能证明这些性状从不受选择。
text.en: The same study used average annual offspring production as a proxy for reproductive success and tested its association with male traits; it found no definitive evidence of directional, stabilizing, disruptive, or correlational selection on the measured traits. Annual offspring count is not lifetime reproductive success, and the absence of clear detected selection does not show that these traits are never selected.

sources.title: Kimock et al. (2019) — Male morphological traits are heritable but do not predict reproductive success in a sexually-dimorphic primate

scope.zh: 波多黎各圣地亚哥岛管理型自由活动恒河猴种群的数量遗传和性状选择研究；测量 125 只成年雄性及 21 只亲缘雌性。
scope.en: Quantitative-genetic and trait-selection study of a managed free-ranging rhesus macaque population on Cayo Santiago, Puerto Rico; measurements covered 125 adult males and 21 related females.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 2144

limitations.zh: 来源链接的数量遗传研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。数据来自引入后的管理型岛屿种群；样本偏重成年雄性，遗传率区间较宽，繁殖指标是年均后代数替代量。不能据此概括原生分布区、雌性性状或全种演化史。
limitations.en: Source-linked quantitative-genetics guide, not externally expert-reviewed. Data come from a managed island population established by introduction; the sample is male-heavy, heritability intervals were wide, and reproductive success was proxied by annual offspring count. The findings do not summarize the native range, female traits, or species-wide evolutionary history.

text.zh:
在哥斯达黎加瓜纳卡斯特保护区圣罗莎区域的野外比较中，白面卷尾猴（Cebus imitator）平均每月摄入果实的比例位于杰氏蜘蛛猴与披风吼猴之间；这一排序来自研究者汇总的长期野外饮食研究，不是本次观察直接称量的完整食谱。在 2,107 个取食行为段落、共 26,094 次果实探索记录中，白面卷尾猴比另外两种更常用手触摸果实，样本中拇指与食指长度比也最高。相反，它的嗅闻频率低于杰氏蜘蛛猴，也低于果实摄入比例更低的披风吼猴，说明这个小型比较里饮食比例并不能单独预测嗅觉探索。作者提出手部灵巧度可能与触摸有关，但观察性关联不能证明因果。

研究还比较二色视觉与三色视觉个体：在控制物种后，二色视觉者更常嗅闻并咬后拒弃果实，三色视觉者则更常用手评估隐蔽色果实。这是跨三种灵长类的汇总结果，并非白面卷尾猴单种的独立效应。
text.en:
In a field comparison at Sector Santa Rosa in Costa Rica's Área de Conservación Guanacaste, white-faced capuchins (Cebus imitator) fell between Geoffroy's spider monkeys and mantled howler monkeys in average monthly fruit share. That ranking came from the authors' review of long-term field diet studies, not a direct measurement of each species' complete diet in the focal observations. Across 2,107 feeding bouts and 26,094 fruit-investigation sequences, capuchins used manual touch more often than the other two species, and had the highest thumb-to-index-finger ratio in the sample. By contrast, they sniffed fruit less often than both spider monkeys and the less-frugivorous howlers, so fruit share alone did not predict sniffing in this small comparison. The authors proposed that manual dexterity may relate to touch, but an observational association does not establish causation.

The study also compared dichromatic and trichromatic individuals: after controlling for species, dichromats sniffed and bit/rejected fruit more often, while trichromats touched cryptic fruit more often. This is a pooled result across the three primates, not an independent effect demonstrated for Cebus alone.

sources.title: Melin et al. (2022) — Anatomy and dietary specialization influence sensory behaviour among sympatric primates

scope.zh: 哥斯达黎加瓜纳卡斯特保护区三种野生同域灵长类的果实探索比较；披风吼猴另补充墨西哥伊斯拉阿加尔特佩克种群。含果实取食比例文献汇总、感觉行为和形态代理分析。
scope.en: Comparison of fruit-investigation behaviour in three wild sympatric primates at Sector Santa Rosa, Costa Rica; howler-monkey observations were also supplemented at Isla Agaltepec, Mexico. Includes literature estimates of fruit consumption plus sensory-behaviour and anatomical-proxy analyses.

limitations.zh: 来源链接的局地比较研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。行为数据来自有限的同域群体、特定共享食物和单一哥斯达黎加季节性干林；果实摄入比例另来自满足研究者筛选条件的长期文献。白面卷尾猴食性灵活，研究不能代表其整个分布区、全年食谱或物种普遍的感觉机制。
limitations.en: Source-linked guide to a local comparative study, not externally expert-reviewed. Behavioural data came from a limited set of sympatric groups, shared foods, and one seasonal Costa Rican dry forest; fruit-share estimates came separately from long-term studies selected by the authors. Cebus has a flexible diet, and the study does not describe its full range, year-round diet, or species-wide sensory mechanisms.

text.zh: 在乌干达西部阿尔伯特湖维多利亚尼罗河三角洲，研究者于 2017 年 10 月至 2018 年 9 月沿五条样线开展逐月调查，共记录 186 次鳄类观察。观察记录在 1–2 月和 4–5 月较多，在 7–8 月和 10–11 月较少；个体较常见于三角洲北岸的木本河岸，其次是纸莎草—Vossia 生境。孵化幼体的生境宽度最窄，亚成体最宽。
text.en: In the Victoria Nile delta of Lake Albert, western Uganda, researchers made monthly surveys along five transects from October 2017 to September 2018, recording 186 crocodile observations. Records were most frequent in January–February and April–May and least frequent in July–August and October–November. Crocodiles were encountered most often along woody north-shore riverbanks, followed by papyrus–Vossia habitat. Hatchlings had the narrowest habitat niche breadth and subadults the widest.

sources.title: Behangana et al. (2020) — Ontogenetic habitat use and seasonal activity of Nile crocodiles (Crocodylus niloticus) in the Lake Albert delta, East Africa

scope.zh: 乌干达阿尔伯特湖三角洲一处种群的逐月样线观察、季节活动和体型阶段生境比较；不支持全物种范围推断。
scope.en: Monthly transect observations, seasonal activity and size-class habitat comparisons for one population in the Lake Albert delta, Uganda; does not support species-wide range inference.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 1008

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 来源链接的局地生态研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。结果仅来自乌干达阿尔伯特湖三角洲的一年、五条样线和 186 次观察；观察频次不等同于真实数量，不能代表全分布区种群。
limitations.en: Source-linked local ecology guide, not externally expert-reviewed. Results come from one year, five transects and 186 observations in Uganda's Lake Albert delta; observation frequency is not true abundance and does not represent the full species range.

text.zh: Murray 等比较新几内亚中央高地南北两侧鳄类的头骨形态，并将南部样本描述为霍尔新几内亚鳄（Crocodylus halli）。其北部新几内亚鳄比较材料包括 Sepik 河和 Hunstein 的标本；在比较样本中，北部群体相对南部群体表现为较长上颌骨和较小的躯干后部骨骼比例。这里总结的是分类诊断研究的样本差异，不是覆盖全岛的野外鉴定键。
text.en: Murray and colleagues compared skull morphology in crocodiles from north and south of New Guinea's Central Highlands and described the southern sample as Hall's New Guinea crocodile (Crocodylus halli). Their northern C. novaeguineae comparison material included specimens from the Sepik River and Hunstein. In the compared samples, the northern group had a relatively longer maxilla and smaller postcranial elements than the southern groups. This summarizes differences in a taxonomic diagnosis study, not a field key validated across the island.

sources.title: Murray et al. (2019) — Divergent Morphology among Populations of the New Guinea Crocodile, Crocodylus novaeguineae (Schmidt, 1928): Diagnosis of an Independent Lineage and Description of a New Species

scope.zh: 对中央高地南北两侧比较标本的头骨与外部形态测量，并据此描述南部新种；支持所比较标本的形态诊断，不支持完整分布或全域生态推断。
scope.en: Cranial and external measurements of comparison specimens from north and south of the Central Highlands, leading to a description of a southern species; supports morphology of the compared specimens, not a complete range or species-wide ecology.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 1008

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 来源链接的头骨形态研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。分布于河流系统的完整边界、种群生态和幼体形态鉴定不由这组比较标本单独确定；南部新种的发表也不等于已普查全部新几内亚种群。
limitations.en: Source-linked cranial-morphology guide, not externally expert-reviewed. This specimen comparison alone does not determine all river-system boundaries, population ecology or juvenile identification; describing the southern species is not a census of all New Guinea populations.

text.zh: 一项科特迪瓦调查在 2014–2019 年间于 38 个地点开展 195 次重复调查，并同时研究西非细吻鳄与西非鳄。模型估计细吻鳄的平均探测概率为 0.75；在该研究的估计条件下，至少重复调查两次，才可用 90% 信心水平推断未探测到的物种缺席。遇到渔网的频率与细吻鳄探测率显著负相关。
text.en: A Côte d'Ivoire study conducted 195 repeated surveys at 38 sites from 2014 to 2019 and examined both the West African slender-snouted crocodile and the West African crocodile. The model estimated a mean detection probability of 0.75 for M. cataphractus; under the study's modeled conditions, at least two surveys were needed to infer absence at 90% confidence. Fishing-net encounter rate was significantly negatively associated with detection of M. cataphractus.

sources.title: Ahizi et al. (2021) — Detectability and impact of repetitive surveys on threatened West African crocodylians

scope.zh: 科特迪瓦 38 个地点、2014–2019 年重复调查中两种鳄类的探测概率、环境和人为变量模型；统计结论限定于研究区域与调查设计。
scope.en: Models of detection probability and environmental and human variables for two crocodilians across 38 Côte d'Ivoire sites surveyed repeatedly in 2014–2019; statistical findings are limited to the study area and survey design.

sources.title: Catalogue of Life COL26.8 · source 1008

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 来源链接的局地监测研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。探测概率不是数量估计；渔网关联来自科特迪瓦调查设计，不能无条件外推到全分布区或因果解释为渔网导致探测率变化。
limitations.en: Source-linked local monitoring guide, not externally expert-reviewed. Detection probability is not an abundance estimate. The fishing-net association comes from surveys in Côte d'Ivoire and should not be generalized unconditionally across the range or interpreted as a causal effect.

text.zh: 一项加蓬研究将 Abanda 洞穴系统和周边森林中的矮鳄作为 Osteolaemus tetraspis 研究：洞穴个体主要食用洞穴蟋蟀和蝙蝠，森林个体主要食用淡水甲壳类和昆虫，未在森林个体胃中发现洞穴猎物。洞穴幼体的体况高于森林幼体；成体差异未达统计显著，作者指出样本量偏小可能限制了比较。
text.en: A Gabon study treated dwarf crocodiles from the Abanda cave system and surrounding forest as Osteolaemus tetraspis. Cave animals ate mainly cave crickets and bats; forest animals ate mainly freshwater crustaceans and insects, and cave prey was not found in the forest animals examined. Juvenile cave crocodiles had higher body condition than forest juveniles. The adult difference was not statistically significant, and the authors noted that small sample size may have limited that comparison.

text.zh: 对已知产地的非洲矮鳄进行多基因分析，支持刚果盆地、Ogooué 流域和西非的三个深分化地理谱系。O. tetraspis 模式标本来自加蓬 Ogooué 河流域；原研究强调谱系边界仍需要多类证据。洞穴生态研究沿用 O. tetraspis 名称，但本导读不据此把 Abanda 洞穴群体单独提升为新种，也不将它等同于整个 COL 接受种的分布与生态。
text.en: A multilocus analysis of African dwarf crocodiles from known localities supported three deeply divergent geographic lineages in the Congo Basin, Ogooué Basin and West Africa. The type specimen of O. tetraspis came from the Ogooué River basin in Gabon, and the study emphasized that lineage boundaries require multiple kinds of evidence. The cave-ecology study used the name O. tetraspis; this guide neither raises the Abanda cave population to a separate species nor treats it as representing the full range and ecology of the COL accepted species.

sources.title: Shirley et al. (2017) — Diet and body condition of cave-dwelling dwarf crocodiles (Osteolaemus tetraspis, Cope 1861) in Gabon

scope.zh: 加蓬 Abanda 洞穴与周边森林矮鳄的食性和体况局地比较；沿用原文分类名称，不独立解决洞穴种群的谱系地位。
scope.en: Local comparison of diet and body condition in dwarf crocodiles from Gabon's Abanda caves and nearby forest; follows the paper's taxonomic usage and does not independently resolve the cave population's lineage status.

sources.title: Eaton et al. (2009) — Species-level diversification of African dwarf crocodiles (Genus Osteolaemus): a geographic and phylogenetic perspective

scope.zh: 对多个已知地点样本的线粒体与核基因及有限形态比较，支持三个地理谱系并定位 O. tetraspis 模式产地流域；不直接确定后来的 Abanda 洞穴采样个体归属。
scope.en: Mitochondrial and nuclear markers and limited morphology from multiple known localities support three geographic lineages and identify the basin of the O. tetraspis type locality; the study does not directly assign later Abanda cave samples.

limitations.en: Source-linked local diet and phylogenetic guide, not externally expert-reviewed. Abanda cave ecology cannot be generalized to the species. The relationship between names in older studies and the cave population under later taxonomic frameworks has not been directly tested on the same specimens.

text.zh: 斯里兰卡一项 2019 年粪便调查覆盖 14 个地点，研究者检测了 180 份样本，分别来自三个地理亚种；每个亚种的城市、城郊和野外生境各采 20 份。这个设计比较的是受调查地点和时段中的粪样检出情况，不是全分布区普查。
text.en: A 2019 fecal survey in Sri Lanka covered 14 sites and examined 180 samples assigned to three geographic subspecies. Within each subspecies, 20 samples came from each of urban, suburban, and wild habitats. This design compares fecal detections at the sampled places and times; it is not a census of the species across its range.

text.zh: 在干旱区指名亚种 M. s. sinica 的样本中，城市、城郊和野外组的寄生虫阳性率依次为 90%（18/20）、70%（14/20）和 45%（9/20）；研究报告城市与野外组差异显著（χ²=9.231，p=.002）。这是横断面地点比较，不能证明城市化导致感染；粪便检出也不等于个体出现临床疾病。论文题名虽提及人兽共患寄生虫，这项调查并未检验猴与人之间的传播事件。
text.en: In the sampled dry-zone subspecies M. s. sinica, parasite-positive samples were 90% (18/20) in urban sites, 70% (14/20) in suburban sites, and 45% (9/20) in wild sites. The authors reported a significant urban–wild contrast (χ²=9.231, p=.002). This cross-sectional comparison does not show that urbanization caused infection, and a fecal detection is not a clinical diagnosis. Although the article title refers to zoonotic parasites, this survey did not test transmission between macaques and people.

title.zh: Fernando 等（2022）——斯里兰卡紫脸猕猴胃肠道寄生虫与栖息地调查
title.en: Fernando et al. (2022) — Gastrointestinal parasites and habitat in Sri Lankan toque macaques

scope.zh: 2019 年斯里兰卡 14 个地点的横断面粪便调查；比较三个地理亚种及城市、城郊、野外样点。此处的 habitat 结果限于指名亚种 M. s. sinica 的取样组。
scope.en: Cross-sectional fecal survey at 14 Sri Lankan sites in 2019, comparing three geographic subspecies and urban, suburban, and wild sampling locations. The habitat results here are limited to the sampled M. s. sinica subgroup.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是来源链接的局地寄生虫研究导读，并非紫脸猕猴的综合物种介绍，也尚未经过外部领域专家评审。结果限于 2019 年所采的三个亚种与样点；横断面粪便检测不能证明因果、临床患病或人兽传播，也不能代表全分布区、全年或未采样种群。
limitations.en: This source-linked guide covers a local parasite study, not a comprehensive species account; it is not externally expert-reviewed. Results are limited to the subspecies and sites sampled in 2019. Cross-sectional fecal screening does not establish causation, clinical disease, or transmission to people, and cannot represent the full range, all seasons, or unsampled populations.

text.zh: 在斯里兰卡，研究者于 2017 年 12 月至 2019 年 4 月采集了 78 份自由活动紫脸叶猴的新鲜粪样。55% 的样本检出至少一种胃肠道寄生虫；鞭虫 Trichuris trichiura 是报告中最常见的蠕虫，占 15%。这些是受调查种群中的粪样结果，不是对整种猴的临床患病率估计。
text.en: In Sri Lanka, researchers collected 78 fresh fecal samples from free-ranging purple-faced leaf monkeys between December 2017 and April 2019. At least one gastrointestinal parasite type was detected in 55% of samples; the most prevalent reported helminth was the whipworm Trichuris trichiura, at 15%. These are fecal results from surveyed groups, not a clinical disease estimate for the species as a whole.

text.zh: 研究报告鞭虫检出率与猴群大小有关；鞭虫和蛔虫 Ascaris lumbricoides 的检出率也随栖息地类型而不同。它们是在当地样本中观察到的关联，不能判定群体大小或栖息地是否造成感染。粪便筛查不能单独诊断个体患病，研究也没有证明猴与人之间发生传播。
text.en: The study reported a relationship between whipworm prevalence and troop size, as well as habitat differences in detection of T. trichiura and the roundworm Ascaris lumbricoides. These are associations in local samples; they do not establish that troop size or habitat caused infection. Fecal screening alone does not diagnose illness in an individual, and the study did not demonstrate transmission between monkeys and people.

title.zh: Weerasekara 等（2021）——斯里兰卡紫脸叶猴胃肠道寄生虫、群体大小与栖息地
title.en: Weerasekara et al. (2021) — Gastrointestinal parasites, troop size, and habitat in Sri Lankan purple-faced leaf monkeys

scope.zh: 2017 年 12 月至 2019 年 4 月，在斯里兰卡自由活动紫脸叶猴样群采集的 78 份新鲜粪样；不代表完整分布区。
scope.en: Seventy-eight fresh fecal samples from surveyed free-ranging purple-faced leaf monkey groups in Sri Lanka, collected from December 2017 to April 2019; not a full-range survey.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是局地研究导读，而非紫脸叶猴综合物种介绍；尚未经过外部领域专家评审。采样只覆盖斯里兰卡若干研究群体和 2017—2019 年时段，不能代表全分布区或当前寄生虫状况。栖息地和猴群大小的相关性不是因果证据；来源页面未确认开放许可，因此仅概述摘要报告的结果。
limitations.en: This is a local research guide, not a comprehensive purple-faced leaf monkey account; it is not externally expert-reviewed. Sampling covered surveyed groups in Sri Lanka during 2017–2019, not the full range or current parasite status. Associations with habitat and troop size are not causal evidence. The publisher page did not confirm an open license, so this guide paraphrases abstract-level findings only.

text.zh: 2001—2002 年的斯里兰卡调查覆盖五个生态区的 31 个地点。约 766 km 的样线经过 17 个未发现懒猴的区域；另在 14 个有记录的地点行走或乘车调查 192 km，共观察到 185 次懒猴。路线观察刻画的是这次调查的记录，不是全岛个体数量。
text.en: A 2001–2002 survey in Sri Lanka covered 31 sites across five ecological zones. About 766 km of survey effort crossed 17 areas with no loris sightings; another 192 km was walked or motored at 14 sites where 185 sightings were recorded. These route observations describe the survey record, not the number of lorises across the island.

text.zh: 按论文当时使用的分类，指名亚种 L. t. tardigradus 有 69 次观察，L. t. nycticeboides 仅 1 次；作者为前者报告了按每公里路线观察估算的 0.86—13 只/km 密度范围。该范围受调查路线与时期限制，不能代表当前全种密度；一次观察也不足以估算 nycticeboides 的密度或现况。
text.en: Under the paper’s taxonomic usage, 69 sightings were assigned to the nominate form L. t. tardigradus and one to L. t. nycticeboides. The authors reported a sightings-based density range of 0.86–13 animals per kilometre for L. t. tardigradus. That range is limited to the surveyed routes and period, not a current species-wide density; one sighting cannot estimate density or present status for nycticeboides.

title.zh: Nekaris 与 Jayewardene（期刊卷期标 2004，2006 年首次在线发表）——斯里兰卡懒猴调查
title.en: Nekaris and Jayewardene (2004 issue; first published online 2006) — Sri Lankan slender loris survey

scope.zh: 2001—2002 年斯里兰卡五个生态区的调查；页面报告 31 个地点和四种研究时使用的懒猴分类单元。物种计数限于 L. tardigradus 的两种旧研究标签。
scope.en: A 2001–2002 survey across five ecological zones in Sri Lanka; the paper reports 31 sites and four study-era slender-loris taxa. This species entry uses only the two historical study labels assigned to L. tardigradus.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是局地调查导读，不是红色细懒猴综合物种介绍，也尚未经过外部领域专家评审。调查仅发生于 2001—2002 年，目击次数和密度范围不代表现今种群。论文用亚种名记录的四个形态分类单元属于其研究时的分类口径；本页保留该口径，不将其直接推广为当前各地亚种界线。期刊卷期年与首次在线发表日不同，均按出版社页面保留。
limitations.en: This is a local survey guide, not a comprehensive red slender loris account; it is not externally expert-reviewed. The survey dates to 2001–2002; sightings and density ranges do not describe current populations. The paper’s subspecific labels reflect its study-era taxonomy and are not projected onto present-day boundaries across the range. The publisher page gives different issue and first-online years, both of which are retained.

text.zh: 2001—2002 年的斯里兰卡调查覆盖五个生态区的 31 个地点。约 766 km 的样线经过 17 个未发现懒猴的区域；另在 14 个有记录的地点行走或乘车调查 192 km，共观察到 185 次懒猴。路线观察刻画的是这次调查的记录，不是全岛个体数量。
text.en: A 2001–2002 survey in Sri Lanka covered 31 sites across five ecological zones. About 766 km of survey effort crossed 17 areas with no loris sightings; another 192 km was walked or motored at 14 sites where 185 sightings were recorded. These route observations describe the survey record, not the number of lorises across the island.

text.zh: 按论文当时使用的分类，L. l. nordicus 有 111 次观察，L. l. grandis 有 4 次；作者为 nordicus 报告了按每公里路线观察估算的 0.33—50 只/km 密度范围。样本数量和估算均对应当年的调查与旧研究标签，不能解读为现今全种数量或整个分布区的密度。
text.en: Under the paper’s taxonomic usage, 111 sightings were assigned to L. l. nordicus and four to L. l. grandis. The authors reported a sightings-based density range of 0.33–50 animals per kilometre for nordicus. Both counts and estimates belong to that survey and its historical labels; they are not current species totals or densities across the full range.

title.zh: Nekaris 与 Jayewardene（期刊卷期标 2004，2006 年首次在线发表）——斯里兰卡懒猴调查
title.en: Nekaris and Jayewardene (2004 issue; first published online 2006) — Sri Lankan slender loris survey

scope.zh: 2001—2002 年斯里兰卡五个生态区的调查；页面报告 31 个地点和四种研究时使用的懒猴分类单元。物种计数限于 L. lydekkerianus 的两种旧研究标签。
scope.en: A 2001–2002 survey across five ecological zones in Sri Lanka; the paper reports 31 sites and four study-era slender-loris taxa. This species entry uses only the two historical study labels assigned to L. lydekkerianus.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是局地调查导读，不是灰色细懒猴综合物种介绍，也尚未经过外部领域专家评审。调查仅发生于 2001—2002 年，目击次数和密度范围不代表现今种群。论文用亚种名记录的四个形态分类单元属于其研究时的分类口径；本页保留该口径，不将其直接推广为当前各地亚种界线。期刊卷期年与首次在线发表日不同，均按出版社页面保留。
limitations.en: This is a local survey guide, not a comprehensive gray slender loris account; it is not externally expert-reviewed. The survey dates to 2001–2002; sightings and density ranges do not describe current populations. The paper’s subspecific labels reflect its study-era taxonomy and are not projected onto present-day boundaries across the range. The publisher page gives different issue and first-online years, both of which are retained.

text.zh: 在南非 Limpopo 省 Nylsvley 自然保护区，研究者于 2009 年 3—8 月捕获 23 只莫霍尔小婴猴，并监测自由活动个体的皮肤温度；另有实验室和室外围栏代谢测量。20 只纳入摘要比较的动物中，15% 出现 torpor。
text.en: At Nylsvley Nature Reserve in Limpopo, South Africa, researchers captured 23 Mohol bushbabies from March to August 2009 and monitored skin temperature in free-ranging animals, alongside laboratory and outdoor-enclosure metabolic measurements. The abstract reports torpor in 15% of the 20 animals in its comparison.

text.zh: 详细结果显示，自由活动亚成体雄性在最冷的 7 月九个监测日中有六日进入 torpor，每次约四小时；另两只动物只在实验室代谢测量期间、经历食物和饮水限制后出现该状态。结果说明该种具有进入 torpor 的生理能力，但不是日常行为，也不能据此估算野外常见程度。作者提出繁殖或领地维护可能限制这种节能策略，但这些是讨论中的解释，并非本研究检验的因果机制。
text.en: Detailed results show that one free-ranging subadult male entered torpor on six of nine monitored days in the coldest month, for about four hours each time. Two other animals showed torpor only during laboratory metabolic measurements after food and water restriction. The study supports a physiological capacity for torpor, not a routine behavior or an estimate of how common it is in the wild. The authors discuss possible reproductive or territorial trade-offs, but did not test those explanations as causal mechanisms.

sources.title: Nowack, Mzilikazi, and Dausmann (2010) — Torpor on Demand: Heterothermy in the Non-Lemur Primate Galago moholi

scope.zh: 南非 Nylsvley 单一地点的季节性研究，结合自由活动个体皮温记录与受控代谢测量；不估计全种 torpor 发生率。
scope.en: Seasonal study at one South African site combining skin-temperature monitoring of free-ranging animals with controlled metabolic measurements; it does not estimate species-wide torpor prevalence.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是单项研究导读，不是南方小婴猴综合种志；尚未经过外部领域专家评审。研究只覆盖南非一个保护区及 2009 年季节样本；自然条件下的 torpor 记录来自一只雄性，实验室记录则发生于受控条件。作者关于繁殖和领地维护的解释仍是推测，不能外推为全种现行规律或保护状态。
limitations.en: This is a single-study guide, not a comprehensive Southern lesser galago account; it is not externally expert-reviewed. The work covers one South African reserve and seasonal sampling in 2009; the field torpor record came from one male, while laboratory records arose under controlled conditions. The authors’ explanations involving reproduction and territorial defense remain hypotheses, not species-wide current patterns or a conservation assessment.

text.zh: 一项跨越三处研究地点的野外研究，在坦桑尼亚 Kwakuchinja 记录活动预算，并在塞内加尔 Fongoli 与肯尼亚 Lolldaiga Hills Ranch 收集群体大小资料。Kwakuchinja 的 180 次焦点跟踪中有 140 次达到活动分析的时长门槛，共 31.4 小时。该点位的活动随夜间时段变化：傍晚觅食较多，黎明前静止时间较长。
text.en: A field study covered three sites, recording activity budgets at Kwakuchinja in Tanzania and group-size data at Fongoli in Senegal and Lolldaiga Hills Ranch in Kenya. Of 180 focal follows at Kwakuchinja, 140 met the duration threshold for activity analysis, totaling 31.4 hours. Activity at that site varied through the night: foraging was more prevalent in the evening, while inactivity was higher before dawn.

text.zh: 群体大小记录也随地点而异：Kwakuchinja 的 76 次相遇中 55% 有两只或更多个体；Fongoli 的 185 次记录中 79% 为单独活动，Lolldaiga 的 142 次中 80% 为单独活动。黎明前整体鸣叫率较高，联系叫声在傍晚所占比例相对更高。作者指出，Kwakuchinja 使用焦点跟踪，另外两处主要使用样线调查；方法差异可能影响对附近个体的发现率，因此地点差异不等于该物种固定的社群系统。
text.en: Group-size records differed by site: 55% of 76 encounters at Kwakuchinja involved two or more individuals, whereas 79% of 185 Fongoli records and 80% of 142 Lolldaiga records were solitary. Overall calling rates were higher before dawn, while contact calls made up a relatively larger share in the evening. The authors note that Kwakuchinja used focal follows whereas the other sites relied mainly on transects; method differences may affect detection of nearby animals, so these contrasts do not define a fixed social system for the species.

sources.title: Ellison et al. (2024 issue; first published online 2023) — Activity Budget and Sociality of the Northern Lesser Galago, Galago senegalensis

scope.zh: 坦桑尼亚一个种群的焦点行为观察，加上坦桑尼亚、塞内加尔和肯尼亚三地群体大小记录；各地调查方法不同。
scope.en: Focal behavioral observations at one Tanzanian population plus group-size records from sites in Tanzania, Senegal, and Kenya; methods differed across sites.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是单项研究导读，不是北方小婴猴综合种志；尚未经过外部领域专家评审。活动预算来自坦桑尼亚一个地点的旱季焦点观察；另外两个地点的群体大小记录采用不同调查方法，检测差异不能解释为全种社群模式。研究没有估计全域分布、种群趋势或正式保护状态。
limitations.en: This is a single-study guide, not a comprehensive Northern lesser galago account; it is not externally expert-reviewed. The activity budget comes from dry-season focal observations at one Tanzanian site; group-size records from two other sites used different survey methods, so detection differences cannot be read as a species-wide social pattern. The study does not estimate the full range, population trend, or formal conservation status.

text.zh: 老挝北部 Tam Pà Ling 洞穴的研究将额骨碎片 TPL 6 和胫骨碎片 TPL 7 归为 Homo sapiens。基于沉积物光释光测年和哺乳动物牙齿铀系及铀系—电子自旋共振结果建立的地点年代模型，报告 TPL 6 为 70 ± 3 千年前、TPL 7 将记录延伸至 77 ± 9 千年前；这些是洞穴沉积年代背景，不是直接测得人类化石的年龄。作者指出，TPL 7 所在位置比最深的沉积物样本低 30 厘米，因此它可能比模型估计还早。
text.en: A study at Tam Pà Ling cave in northern Laos attributes the frontal fragment TPL 6 and tibial fragment TPL 7 to Homo sapiens. A site chronology model based on sediment luminescence dating and uranium-series and combined uranium-series–electron spin resonance results from mammal teeth places TPL 6 at 70 ± 3 thousand years and extends the record with TPL 7 to 77 ± 9 thousand years. These estimates describe the cave sequence, not direct dates on the human fossils. The authors note that TPL 7 lies 30 cm below the deepest sediment sample and may therefore be older than the modeled estimate.

text.zh: TPL 6 是左侧额骨残片，眉弓较弱且没有古人类常见的眶上圆枕；作者的形态比较将它归入较纤细的额骨形态。TPL 7 是近端左胫骨碎片，埋藏改造严重，无法准确测量骨骼尺寸。两件标本只呈现一个地点的化石材料，不能概括智人的物种内形态差异。
text.en: TPL 6 is a partial left frontal bone with a modest superciliary arch and no supraorbital torus of the kind described for archaic humans; the authors’ shape comparison places it among more gracile frontal forms. TPL 7 is a proximal left tibial fragment whose taphonomic alteration prevents accurate osteometric analysis. These two specimens from one site do not describe morphological variation across Homo sapiens.

text.zh: 德国 Ranis 的 Ilsenhöhle 洞穴研究对 10 份人类遗骸胶原蛋白进行了稳定同位素分析，并结合 52 份动物遗骸。结果支持这些约四万五千年前的洞穴样本人群以大型陆生哺乳动物为主要饮食信号，生活在寒冷草原—苔原环境中。该推断来自单一洞穴的考古样本和地层背景；同位素结果不能证明每种动物都在洞内被捕食或食用，也不能代表智人的普遍食谱。
text.en: At Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, Germany, researchers analyzed collagen stable isotopes from 10 human remains alongside 52 animal remains. The results support a dietary signal dominated by large terrestrial mammals for the sampled people, associated with a cold steppe–tundra setting about 45,000 years ago. This inference comes from archaeological samples at one cave and its stratigraphic context; the isotope results do not show that every animal taxon was hunted or eaten at the site, and they do not describe a general Homo sapiens diet.

sources.title: Freidline et al. (2023) — Early presence of Homo sapiens in Southeast Asia by 86–68 kyr at Tam Pà Ling, Northern Laos

scope.zh: 老挝北部单一洞穴地点的化石形态与沉积年代研究；地点年代模型不等同于化石直接测年。
scope.en: Fossil morphology and site chronology at one cave in northern Laos; modeled site ages are not direct dates on the human fossils.

sources.title: Smith et al. (2024) — The ecology, subsistence and diet of ~45,000-year-old Homo sapiens at Ilsenhöhle in Ranis, Germany

scope.zh: 德国 Ranis 单一洞穴的稳定同位素研究，包含 10 份人类遗骸和 52 份动物遗骸；饮食推断限于该考古样本。
scope.en: Stable-isotope study at one cave in Ranis, Germany, with 10 human remains and 52 animal remains; the dietary inference is limited to that archaeological sample.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级与分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是依据两个考古地点研究撰写的来源链接导读，不是智人综合种志，也尚未经过外部领域专家评审。Tam Pà Ling 的年代是沉积序列模型，TPL 7 可能早于模型估计；Ranis 的饮食结论限于 10 份人类遗骸和一处洞穴。两项研究都不能代表全物种形态、饮食、现今分布、种群趋势或正式保育状态。
limitations.en: This source-linked guide draws on studies from two archaeological sites; it is not a comprehensive Homo sapiens account and is not externally expert-reviewed. Tam Pà Ling ages come from a depositional sequence model, and TPL 7 may predate its estimate; the Ranis dietary result is limited to 10 human remains at one cave. Neither study describes species-wide morphology, diet, current range, population trend, or a formal conservation status.

text.zh: 一项长期岛屿种群研究考察春季气温、种群大小与家麻雀幼鸟扩散率的关系，并比较栖境质量不同的岛屿。在没有农场、被研究者视为较低质量的岛屿上，较高的春季气温和较大的当地种群与更高的幼鸟扩散率相关；在有农场、全年可获得食物和庇护的较高质量岛屿上，扩散率则未随这两项因素明显变化。结果提示，这组种群中的扩散关联随栖境而异，不能简化成所有地点一致的气候或密度效应。
text.en: A long-term island population study examined how spring temperature and population size related to natal dispersal in house sparrows, comparing islands that differed in habitat quality. On lower-quality islands without farms, warmer springs and larger local populations were associated with higher natal dispersal. On higher-quality islands with farms, where food and shelter were available throughout the year, dispersal showed no clear relationship with those two factors. The findings indicate that these associations varied across the studied habitats, rather than showing one uniform climate or density effect across all sites.

sources.title: Pärn et al. (2012 issue; DOI registered 2011) — Spatial heterogeneity in the effects of climate and density-dependence on dispersal in a house sparrow metapopulation

scope.zh: 长期岛屿种群研究的摘要报告，比较无农场与有农场岛屿中气候、种群大小和幼鸟扩散的关联；正文范围与样本细节本页未扩展。
scope.en: Abstract-level report from a long-term island population study comparing associations of climate, population size, and natal dispersal on islands without and with farms; this guide does not expand beyond the available abstract.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级与分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是根据一篇研究摘要撰写的局地导读，不是家麻雀综合种志，也尚未经过外部领域专家评审。全文页面未能打开，故只概述摘要明确报告的关联；期刊页面所示版权声明不足以确认本文具有开放许可，因此不复用长段原文。研究的岛屿栖境关联不能外推为全种普遍机制，也不证明温度或种群大小造成扩散变化；本文不评估现今分布、种群趋势或正式保育状态。
limitations.en: This is a local guide based on one study abstract, not a comprehensive house sparrow account, and it is not externally expert-reviewed. The full-text page could not be opened, so the guide paraphrases only findings stated in the abstract; the available copyright notice does not confirm an open license, and no extended text is reused. Associations across the studied island habitats do not establish a species-wide mechanism or prove that temperature or population size caused dispersal changes. The study does not assess the current range, population trend, or formal conservation status.

text.zh: Henderson 等在苏格兰 Loch Lomond 附近的巢箱种群中，连续三个繁殖季观察自由生活的蓝山雀。亲鸟基线皮质酮较高，与较低气温、较多降雨和领地尺度橡树密度较低相关；这些是同一研究中的环境关联，不表示任一因素单独造成激素变化。
text.en: Henderson and colleagues monitored free-living blue tits at nest boxes near Loch Lomond, Scotland, across three breeding seasons. Higher parental baseline corticosterone was associated with lower temperatures, more rainfall, and lower territory-scale oak density. These are environmental associations within one study and do not show that any one factor alone caused a change in hormone levels.

text.zh: 毛虫食物高峰与育雏时间错开时，雏鸟体重和离巢成功率较低，但这种食物时序错配没有与亲鸟皮质酮相关。研究所测环境变量中，只有低温同时关联较轻的雏鸟和较高的亲鸟皮质酮。不同指标并未沿着一条简单、相同的关系变化。
text.en: When breeding was out of sync with the caterpillar food peak, nestlings were lighter and fledging success was lower, but this timing mismatch was not associated with parental corticosterone. Among the environmental variables measured, only low temperature was associated with both lighter nestlings and higher parental corticosterone. The different measures did not follow one simple, shared relationship.

text.zh: 各研究年中，皮质酮较高亲鸟的雏鸟体重较轻；但在 2009 年，亲鸟皮质酮又与离巢幼鸟数量呈正相关。因此，这项研究不支持把皮质酮简单当作繁殖成败的通用刻度。作者指出，解读生理指标还要同时考虑当年的环境条件。
text.en: In each study year, offspring of parents with higher corticosterone were lighter; yet in 2009 parental corticosterone was positively associated with the number of young fledged. The study therefore does not support treating corticosterone as a simple, general measure of breeding success. The authors emphasize interpreting this physiological measure alongside environmental conditions in each year.

sources.title: Henderson et al. (2017) — Do glucocorticoids predict fitness? Linking environmental conditions, corticosterone and reproductive success in the blue tit, Cyanistes caeruleus

scope.zh: 苏格兰 Loch Lomond 附近巢箱种群的三年繁殖期观察；测量育雏期环境、亲鸟基线皮质酮和繁殖结果。
scope.en: Three breeding seasons of observations at a nest-box population near Loch Lomond, Scotland; the study measured brood-rearing conditions, parental baseline corticosterone, and reproductive outcomes.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是单项局地研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。三年观察来自一处苏格兰巢箱种群，报告的是相关性，不能证明皮质酮或天气造成了繁殖结果，也不代表蓝山雀全域、其他生活史阶段或不同年份的普遍规律。
limitations.en: This is a local, single-study guide and is not externally expert-reviewed. The three years of observations came from one Scottish nest-box population and report associations; they do not establish that corticosterone or weather caused reproductive outcomes, or define general patterns across the blue tit's range, other life stages, or different years.

text.zh: 斑胸草雀常被用来研究鸣唱学习。Warren 等 2010 年的基因组论文将它描述为鸣唱习得研究模型，并据此分析与大脑和鸣唱相关的基因表达；这里介绍的是研究为何关注这种鸟，不是对野外鸣唱行为的完整调查。
text.en: Zebra finches are widely used to study learned song. Warren and colleagues' 2010 genome paper described the species as a model for vocal learning and analyzed gene expression relevant to the brain and song; this is context for the research, not a comprehensive field study of wild song behavior.

text.zh: 该研究测序并组装了一只雄性斑胸草雀的基因组：约 12 亿碱基的草图组装中，约 10 亿碱基被定位到 33 条染色体和 3 个连锁群。研究还比较了幼鸟鸣唱学习关键期（孵化后 50 天）与成年期（850 天）前脑样本的基因表达；这两个年龄点不代表完整发育轨迹。
text.en: The study sequenced and assembled a male zebra finch genome: about 1.2 billion bases in the draft assembly, with about 1.0 billion assigned to 33 chromosomes and three linkage groups. It also compared forebrain gene expression at 50 days after hatching, during the juvenile song-learning period, and at 850 days in adults; these two ages do not represent a complete developmental trajectory.

text.zh: 与鸡基因组的比较显示，两者整体共线性和核型较为保守，同时存在较多染色体内部重排。这个结论来自当时对两条鸟类谱系的比较；它既不是所有鸟类共有特征的完整清单，也不能替代后续增加物种和改进组装后的比较。
text.en: Comparison with the chicken genome found broadly conserved synteny and karyotype, alongside many intrachromosomal rearrangements. This conclusion came from a comparison of two bird lineages at the time; it is neither a complete inventory of traits shared by all birds nor a substitute for later comparisons with more species and improved assemblies.

sources.title: Warren et al. (2010) — The genome of a songbird

scope.zh: 雄性斑胸草雀草图基因组、两个年龄点的前脑表达资料，以及与鸡的比较基因组分析。
scope.en: A male zebra-finch draft genome, forebrain expression data at two ages, and comparative genomic analysis with chicken.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是单篇基因组研究导读，不是斑胸草雀综合种志，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。基因组来自一只雄鸟，比较对象是鸡；基因组组装、两个人生年龄点和鸣唱相关分子结果均受该研究设计及 2010 年组装版本限制，不代表全种地理变异或当前参考组装。
limitations.en: This is a guide to one genome study, not a comprehensive zebra-finch account, and it is not externally expert-reviewed. The genome came from one male and the comparison was with chicken; the assembly, two sampled ages, and song-related molecular results are limited by that study design and its 2010 assembly, and do not represent species-wide geographic variation or a current reference assembly.

text.zh: 美国鱼类及野生动物管理局恢复计划按 2025 年 12 月 31 日统计全球共 607 只加州神鹫：392 只在野外自由飞行，215 只处于圈养种群。这里的“野外”计数属于持续管理和放归计划的一部分，不能单独读成不依赖管理的自然种群规模。
text.en: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service recovery program counted 607 California condors worldwide on 31 December 2025: 392 free-flying in the wild and 215 in the captive population. The wild count is part of an ongoing management and release program and should not be read on its own as the size of a population independent of management.

text.zh: 报告将野外个体分列为亚利桑那／犹他 98 只、加州 216 只、太平洋西北实验种群 25 只、下加利福尼亚 53 只。太平洋西北种群与加州群体空间分离，报告没有把它并入加州的 216 只。
text.en: The report divided the wild birds into 98 in Arizona/Utah, 216 in California, 25 in the experimental Pacific Northwest population, and 53 in Baja California. The Pacific Northwest population is spatially separate from the California flocks and is not included in California's count of 216.

text.zh: 同一年度有 16 只雏鸟被记为在野外离巢，另有 46 只圈养繁育个体放归野外；野外自由飞行种群记录到 22 只死亡。年度总量因此同时反映繁殖、放归和损失，而不是只靠自然出生数解释的单一趋势。
text.en: The same annual report recorded 16 chicks fledged in the wild, 46 captive-bred birds released, and 22 deaths among the free-flying wild population. The annual total therefore reflects breeding, releases, and losses together, rather than a trend explained by natural births alone.

text.zh: 2025 年 22 只野外死亡中，9 只确认死于铅中毒，另 9 只等待最终尸检结果。恢复计划还汇总称，1992—2025 年野外共有 161 例确认的铅中毒死亡，占已知死因死亡的 50%、所有野外死亡的 28%；这些是报告的历史累计数，不是未来风险预测。
text.en: Of 22 wild deaths in 2025, nine were confirmed as lead poisoning and nine awaited final necropsy results. The recovery program also reported 161 confirmed lead-poisoning deaths in the wild from 1992 to 2025, representing 50% of deaths with known causes and 28% of all wild deaths. These are historical totals in the report, not a prediction of future risk.

sources.title: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service — 2025 Annual Population Status

scope.zh: 恢复计划截至 2025-12-31 的全球管理种群统计，包括野外自由飞行和圈养个体、各区域计数、年度繁殖／放归／死亡与历史死因。
scope.en: Recovery-program counts as of 2025-12-31, including free-flying wild and captive birds, regional totals, annual fledging/releases/deaths, and historical causes of death.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是管理计划年度计数导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审，也不是完整物种介绍、正式风险等级评估或种群存续力分析。所有数字绑定 2025-12-31 和报告定义；野外总数包含受管理、放归及自由飞行个体，年度雏鸟数字还包含依据亲鸟行为判定的偏远巢位记录。
limitations.en: This is a guide to an annual recovery-program count and is not externally expert-reviewed; it is also not a comprehensive species account, formal risk assessment, or population-viability analysis. All figures are tied to 2025-12-31 and the report's definitions; the wild total includes managed, released, free-flying birds, and the annual fledgling figure includes remote nests inferred from parental behavior.

text.zh: 一项圈养研究观察雌性倭蜂猴从单独饲养转入群体笼舍前后的行为与粪便皮质醇。论文使用旧属名 Nycticebus pygmaeus；COL26.8 当前接受名为 Xanthonycticebus pygmaeus。
text.en: A captive study tracked female pygmy slow lorises before and after they moved from solitary housing into group enclosures, recording behavior and fecal cortisol. The paper used the earlier genus name Nycticebus pygmaeus; COL26.8 currently accepts Xanthonycticebus pygmaeus.

text.zh: 群体饲养后，雌性个体的粪便皮质醇水平较低；一只单独饲养时表现刻板行为的雌性，在转入群体笼舍后不再表现该行为。研究把这些变化放在圈养福利情境中讨论，并未直接观察野外倭蜂猴的社群结构。
text.en: After group housing, the females had lower fecal cortisol levels; one female that showed stereotypic behavior while housed alone no longer showed it after moving to a group enclosure. The study discusses these changes in a captive-welfare context and did not observe the species' social organization in the wild.

sources.title: Alejandro et al. (2021) — Behavioral Changes of Solitary Housed Female Pygmy Slow Lorises after Introduction into Group Enclosures

scope.zh: 论文以 Nycticebus pygmaeus 名义研究圈养雌性个体从单独饲养转入群体笼舍前后的行为和粪便皮质醇。
scope.en: The article, using the name Nycticebus pygmaeus, studied behavior and fecal cortisol in captive females before and after transfer from solitary housing to group enclosures.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 这是局地圈养福利研究导读，不是倭蜂猴综合种志，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。观察对象为数量有限的圈养雌性，不能据此推断野外社会系统、全种皮质醇规律或野外生境和食性。
limitations.en: This is a local captive-welfare guide, not a comprehensive pygmy slow loris account, and is not externally expert-reviewed. It concerns a limited number of captive females and cannot establish wild social organization, species-wide cortisol patterns, habitat, or diet.

text.zh: 论文提及巴西 Paranaíta 一带曾有斯皮克斯吼猴与作者所称 Alouatta puruensis 同域的记录，并讨论中游 Juruena 河附近可能的接触区。作者提出潜在杂交带假说，但没有确认基因交流。COL26.8 当前没有接受种级的 A. puruensis 对应项；本页保留论文用名，不将它擅自匹配到其他接受种。
text.en: The paper notes an earlier record of Spix's howler occurring with the paper's Alouatta puruensis in the Paranaíta area and discusses a possible contact zone near the middle Juruena River. The authors propose a potential hybrid zone but do not confirm gene flow. COL26.8 currently has no accepted species usage for A. puruensis; this page preserves the paper's name rather than mapping it to another accepted species.

sources.title: Costa-Araújo et al. (2024) — A dataset of new occurrence records of primates from the arc of deforestation, Brazil

scope.zh: 巴西南部亚马逊地区 2015–2018 年野外记录；本文只转述 Juruena–Teles Pires 地区的局部范围与接触区假说。
scope.en: Field records from southern Amazonia, Brazil, during 2015–2018; this page uses only the local range and contact-zone discussion for the Juruena–Teles Pires region.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 局部范围与分类接触研究导读，不是全种种志、数量估计或保育评估；所涉杂交与基因交流仍是假说。尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: A local range and taxonomic-contact guide, not a complete species account, abundance estimate, or conservation assessment; hybridization and gene flow remain hypotheses. This guide is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 2015–2018 年野外调查在中游 Teles Pires 河右岸记录到两处黑色被毛、额部和面颊没有白毛的蜘蛛猴，研究者据外观将其鉴定为查梅克蜘蛛猴；这些地点落在白颊蜘蛛猴的已绘范围内，其中一处与白颊蜘蛛猴记录重叠。作者提出河中岛屿可能帮助个体跨河扩散，但是否存在持续基因交流仍待更多记录和遗传样本检验。
text.en: Field expeditions during 2015–2018 recorded two black-pelaged spider monkeys without the white forehead and cheek hairs characteristic of the white-cheeked spider monkey on the right bank of the middle Teles Pires River. The authors identified them as Chamek spider monkeys; the points fall within the mapped range of the white-cheeked species, and one overlaps its record. River islands may facilitate crossings, but ongoing gene flow remains to be tested with more records and genetic samples.

sources.title: Costa-Araújo et al. (2024) — A dataset of new occurrence records of primates from the arc of deforestation, Brazil

scope.zh: 巴西南部亚马逊的局部野外出现记录与作者提出的跨河扩散假说。
scope.en: Local occurrence records and the authors' proposed river-crossing dispersal hypothesis in southern Amazonia, Brazil.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 结论限于几处河岸记录和形态鉴定；跨河扩散与基因交流是待检验解释，不是完整分布、种群趋势或保育评估。尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: Evidence is limited to a few riverbank records and phenotype-based identification; dispersal and gene flow are hypotheses to test, not a complete range account, population trend, or conservation assessment. This guide is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 在巴西中游 Teles Pires 河右岸，一处白颊蜘蛛猴记录与新记录的查梅克蜘蛛猴地点重叠。研究者依据黑色被毛以及额部、面颊的白毛差异区分这两种蜘蛛猴，并提出河中岛屿可能形成跨河通道。研究没有直接测量迁移或基因交流；作者认为仍需补充野外记录和遗传样本。
text.en: On the right bank of Brazil's middle Teles Pires River, one white-cheeked spider monkey locality overlaps a new record of the Chamek spider monkey. The study distinguished the two using black pelage and the presence or absence of white hairs on the forehead and cheeks, and proposed that river islands may provide crossing routes. It did not directly measure migration or gene flow; the authors call for more field records and genetic samples.

sources.title: Costa-Araújo et al. (2024) — A dataset of new occurrence records of primates from the arc of deforestation, Brazil

scope.zh: 巴西 Teles Pires 河中游的局部记录重叠与跨河扩散假说。
scope.en: Local record overlap and a proposed river-crossing hypothesis in the middle Teles Pires region of Brazil.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 单一地区的记录重叠不代表两种全域同域，也不能证明跨河扩散或杂交。页面是局部研究导读，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: Record overlap at one locality does not establish range-wide sympatry or prove river crossing or hybridization. This is a local-study guide and is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 一篇覆盖巴西南部亚马逊多条河流间地的出现记录研究，提出重新界定红腹绢毛猴的区域分布范围，并把近年描述的 Plecturocebus grovesi 与 P. vieirai 从旧有 P. moloch 范围中分别处理。作者同时指出，P. moloch 的模式产地、两个历史异名的有效性，以及 Jamanxim–Teles Pires 河间地绢毛猴的分类仍待澄清。
text.en: An occurrence-record study across interfluves in southern Amazonia proposed a revised regional range for the red-bellied titi and treated the recently described Plecturocebus grovesi and P. vieirai separately from areas previously assigned to P. moloch. The authors also note unresolved issues involving P. moloch's type locality, two historical synonyms, and titi taxonomy in the Jamanxim–Teles Pires interfluve.

sources.title: Costa-Araújo et al. (2024) — A dataset of new occurrence records of primates from the arc of deforestation, Brazil

scope.zh: 基于巴西南部亚马逊的局部出现记录提出区域分布界定，并说明仍未解决的分类问题。
scope.en: Regional range delimitation from occurrence records in southern Amazonia, Brazil, with outstanding taxonomic questions.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 区域分布界定不是全种调查；论文明确保留模式产地、异名和局地分类问题。尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: The regional delimitation is not a complete species-wide survey; the paper leaves type-locality, synonym, and local taxonomy questions open. This guide is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 研究在以往划给霍夫曼绢毛猴的区域内记录到巴蒂斯塔绢毛猴，并指出该地还有先前的类似记录。作者提出两种绢毛猴可能表现为连续的毛色变化，或许属于单一物种，但强调相关分类与分布研究不足，且当时没有把两者纳入分子系统发育分析。
text.en: The study recorded a Lake Baptista titi within an area then attributed to Hoffmann's titi and noted earlier records from the same area. The authors proposed that the two forms might represent clinal pelage variation within one species, while emphasizing that their taxonomy and distribution were poorly studied and that they had not been compared in a molecular phylogenetic analysis.

scope.en: One P. baptista record in southern Amazonia and its geographic relation to the range attributed to P. hoffmannsi; species-boundary interpretation remains hypothetical.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.en: A local overlap record and a proposed clinal pelage explanation do not resolve range-wide distribution or species boundaries. This guide is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 野外调查在传统上归于霍夫曼绢毛猴的分布范围内记录到巴蒂斯塔绢毛猴。论文指出两者研究稀少、尚未接受共同的分子系统发育分析，并提出它们的毛色可能是连续变化、而非清晰分界的种间差异；这是待检验解释，不是本研究得出的分类修订。
text.en: Fieldwork recorded a Lake Baptista titi within the range traditionally attributed to Hoffmann's titi. The paper notes that the forms are poorly studied and had not been included together in a molecular phylogenetic analysis. It raises continuous pelage variation, rather than a sharp interspecific boundary, as an explanation to test—not as a taxonomic revision established by this study.

text.zh: 巴西南部亚马逊的多次野外调查在 Jamanxim 河左岸、上游 Tapajós 河和下游 Teles Pires 河右岸记录到柯林斯松鼠猴。作者据这些出现点估算，其已知分布向西扩展约 600 公里。这是对区域范围的更新，不是完整分布普查或种群数量估计。
text.en: Field expeditions in southern Amazonia, Brazil, recorded Collins' squirrel monkey on the left bank of the Jamanxim River and on the right banks of the upper Tapajós and lower Teles Pires rivers. From these occurrence points, the authors estimated a westward range extension of about 600 km. This updates a regional range account; it is not a complete range survey or population estimate.
