text.zh: 在几内亚 Bossou 对野生西部黑猩猩群体的 2012–2013 年跟踪中，成熟林是总体活动中选择比例最高的栖地。非耕地中的取食记录在距耕地超过 200 米处高于随机预期，在 0–100 米与 101–200 米区间低于预期；作者提出，与农田相关的风险可能影响取食位置。结果仅描述一个地点和群体。
text.en: During follows of a wild western-chimpanzee community at Bossou, Guinea, in 2012–2013, mature forest was the most selected habitat overall. In noncultivated habitat, feeding records occurred more often than expected beyond 200 m from fields and less often than expected in the 0–100 m and 101–200 m bands. The authors suggested that field-associated risk may influence feeding locations. These results describe one site and community.

text.zh: 贡贝国家公园 36 只已知年龄野生雌性样本的性成熟平均年龄为 11.5 岁（范围 8.5–13.9 岁），首次生育平均年龄为 14.9 岁（11.1–22.1 岁）。首次生育估计来自较小且含删失记录的子样本；由于未迁出雌性比例偏高，估计值可能偏低。这些是贡贝种群估计，不是全物种固定常数。
text.en: Among 36 known-age wild females at Gombe National Park, mean age at sexual maturity was 11.5 years (range 8.5–13.9), and mean age at first birth was 14.9 years (11.1–22.1). First-birth estimates came from a smaller, censored subset and may be biased low because non-dispersing females were overrepresented. These are Gombe population estimates, not fixed species-wide constants.

text.zh: Taï 国家公园三个相邻西部黑猩猩群体的横断面视频样本覆盖 70 只个体、135 段视频和 1,460 次棍棒使用事件。模型预测，多指握法约在 5.2 岁成为棍棒插入动作中的主要握法，到 15 岁时预测使用概率为 98%。45 岁以上的记录仅有一个群体的 3 只雌性；该年龄模式限于此项棍棒任务，不能证明全物种普遍的发育轨迹或认知成因。
text.en: A cross-sectional video sample from three neighboring western-chimpanzee communities at Taï National Park covered 70 individuals, 135 videos, and 1,460 stick-use events. For stick insertion, the model predicted that the multi-digit grip became predominant at about 5.2 years and had a 98% predicted probability of use by age 15. Observations above age 45 came from only three females in one group. This age pattern is specific to the sampled stick task and does not establish a universal developmental trajectory or cognitive cause.

text.zh: 一项 2016 年厄瓜多尔研究以七只卫星追踪个体的 60 个栖息点和七项 500 米分辨率环境变量建模，估算厄瓜多尔的分布范围面积为 49,550 平方公里、占域面积为 14,106 平方公里。这些是国家尺度的模型输出，不是全球分布图。
text.en: A 2016 Ecuador study modeled 60 roosting locations from seven satellite-tagged condors with seven environmental predictors at 500 m resolution. It estimated an Ecuadorian extent of occurrence of 49,550 km² and area of occupancy of 14,106 km². These are country-level model outputs, not a global range map.

text.zh: 同一研究根据 2015 年连续两日同步普查中记录的 93 只个体，估算厄瓜多尔种群为 94–102 只；其种群生存力情景模型把栖地丧失列为该国最大的模型威胁。论文讨论的是当时已有的国家级极危列名，不是当前 IUCN 或国家级重新评估。
text.en: The same study estimated 94–102 condors in Ecuador from 93 birds counted during a synchronized two-day census in 2015. Its population-viability scenarios identified habitat loss as the greatest modeled threat in that country. The paper discusses an earlier national Critically Endangered listing; it is not a current IUCN or national reassessment.

scope.en: CC BY 4.0 Ecuador study; models used seven tagged birds and 60 roost locations, and the census was a synchronized two-day count in 2015.

It does not establish the current global range, population, or conservation category. The Chinese common name is an editorial translation. This guide is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 一项遗传研究在 2004–2012 年采集罗斯海 Cape Washington、东南极 Pointe Géologie 与两个 Mertz 群、毛德皇后地 Atka Bay、威德尔海 Halley Bay 六个繁殖群样本；作者称其覆盖该种分布区。采样点说明研究范围，不是当前完整分布边界。
text.en: A genetic study sampled six colonies in 2004–2012: Cape Washington in the Ross Sea; Pointe Géologie and two Mertz colonies in East Antarctica; Atka Bay in Dronning Maud Land; and Halley Bay in the Weddell Sea. The authors described them as representing the species’ range. These localities show the study’s sampling frame, not a complete current range boundary.

text.zh: 研究对六个东南极繁殖群的 110 只个体进行 RAD-SNP 分析，并用共祖迁移模型评估群间联系；结果支持较强的人口学连结，作者据此提出单一遗传种群的解释。模型迁移参数是跨世代平均值，不能当作当下迁移率。
text.en: RAD-SNP data from 110 birds at six East Antarctic colonies were analyzed with a coalescent migration model. The results supported strong demographic coupling among colonies, which the authors interpreted as a single genetic population. The model parameters average across generations and are not current migration rates.

text.zh: 一份 2009 年北太平洋状况评估称，当时全球超过 99% 的莱桑信天翁在西北夏威夷群岛繁殖，并记载其在北太平洋觅食、于墨西哥至日本的海洋岛屿繁殖。该比例与分布摘要依据截至 2005 年的评估资料，不是当前全球图集。
text.en: A 2009 North Pacific status assessment reported that more than 99% of Laysan albatrosses nested in the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands at the time. It described foraging across the North Pacific and breeding on oceanic islands from Mexico to Japan. The proportion and range summary reflect assessment evidence through 2005, not a current global atlas.

text.zh: 该评估将莱桑信天翁描述为远洋生活、上岸繁殖的海鸟，并在其回顾期内把商业渔业兼捕列为离巢幼鸟死亡的重要人为来源。这个威胁描述限于报告分析的历史时期，不能解释为当前死亡率。
text.en: The assessment described Laysan albatrosses as open-ocean birds that come ashore to breed and identified commercial-fishery bycatch as an important human-caused source of post-fledging mortality during its review period. This is a historical threat summary, not a current mortality rate.

scope.en: U.S. Geological Survey 2009 North Pacific report; population and status analyses extend through 2005. The report is public domain except for third-party material.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank, and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 数值和威胁陈述来自 2009 年报告、资料止于 2005 年；不能代表当前繁殖比例、渔业死亡率、全球分布或保育等级。中文俗名为编辑性译名。尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: Numerical and threat statements come from a 2009 report with evidence through 2005; they do not establish current breeding proportions, fishery mortality, global distribution, or conservation status. The Chinese common name is an editorial translation. This guide is not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 研究将 IUCN 范围图叠置到巴西亚马逊十个主要间河区，红吼猴（Alouatta seniculus）的范围图与其中五区相交：朗多尼亚、伊南巴里、雅乌、纳波和伊梅里。作者将它列为三种分布较广的大型灵长类之一。这里的“相交”是区域尺度地图结果，不是逐点现场确认。
text.en: The study overlaid IUCN range maps on ten major Brazilian Amazon interfluves; the red howler (Alouatta seniculus) intersects five: Rondônia, Inambari, Jaú, Napo and Imeri. The authors listed it among three large-bodied primates in their broadly distributed group. The overlap is a region-level map result, not point-level field confirmation.

title.zh: Mourthé 等（2022）：巴西亚马逊大型河流对灵长类分布的筛选作用
title.en: Mourthé et al. (2022) — Filtering Effect of Large Rivers on Primate Distribution in the Brazilian Amazonia

scope.zh: 研究使用 IUCN 分布图比较巴西亚马逊十个主要间河区的灵长类组合；补充表 S1 列出范围图与各间河区的相交矩阵。支持区域范围图叠置摘要，不是现场出现点记录、丰度估计或完整分布评估。
scope.en: The study compares primate assemblages across ten major Brazilian Amazon interfluves using IUCN range maps; Supplementary Table S1 gives the range-map overlap matrix for each interfluve. It supports regional map-overlay summaries, not field occurrence points, abundance estimates or complete range assessments.

scope.zh: 固定版本中的接受名、作者、等级和分类父链；不支持生物学正文。
scope.en: Pinned accepted name, authorship, rank and parent classification; not biological evidence.

limitations.zh: 论文摘要与方法称分析 80 种，主文表 2 的间河区占据类别合计为 81 种，并将单一间河区的 46 种报告为 57%，与正文的 58% 不同。本页的区域名单和计数取自补充表 S1；这些数据来自范围图叠置，不是逐点现场确认、种群数量或完整分布评估。中文俗名为编辑译名，尚未经过外部领域专家评审。
limitations.en: The abstract and methods describe 80 species, while main-text Table 2 occupancy classes sum to 81 and report the 46 single-interfluve species as 57%, unlike the 58% stated in the text. The named areas and counts here come from Supplementary Table S1. They are range-map overlaps, not point-level field confirmations, population counts or complete range assessments. Chinese common names are editorial translations, and these guides are not externally expert-reviewed.

text.zh: 研究将 IUCN 范围图叠置到巴西亚马逊十个主要间河区，记录 Alouatta macconnelli 的范围图与 2 个区相交：潘特普伊—杜伊达、圭亚那。这里的“出现”指区域尺度的地图相交，不代表这些地区每个具体地点都确认有个体，也不是种群数量或完整分布区评估。
text.en: The study overlaid IUCN range maps on ten major Brazilian Amazon interfluves and listed Alouatta macconnelli in 2 areas: Pantepui-Duida, Guiana. Here, occurrence means a region-level map overlap; it does not confirm animals at every site in those areas and is not a population count or complete range assessment.
